title: SDET (PAM)
description:
Bitwarden is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to help the team grow confidently by building a suite of automated regression tests and driving a total-quality approach to software development and delivery. You will contribute directly to the future of the Bitwarden product across web, browser extension, mobile, desktop, CLI, and server components, while working with a great team and an amazing open-source community. This role is primarily for someone strong in C#, test automation framework design, CI/CD integration, and engineering-quality test code.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for web, browser extension, mobile, desktop, and CLI applications using C# with Selenium/Appium.
* Design and implement robust, scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks across multiple application types.
* Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline and ensure their reliable execution in build and delivery workflows.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to understand requirements, identify test scenarios, and automate for comprehensive coverage.
* Execute automated tests, analyze results, and surface defects, performance issues, and areas for improvement.
* Review test automation code to uphold coding standards, best practices, and maintainability.
* Establish guidelines and processes for testing community and internal product contributions.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, reporting automation progress, blockers, and upcoming sprint plans.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members on automation best practices and frameworks.
* Document frameworks and processes to support knowledge sharing and long-term maintainability.

**What you Bring**

* Strong C# proficiency with substantial production test-automation experience (3–5 years).
* Senior automation architecture capability: scalable, reusable, maintainable frameworks; readable/testable code; debugging and edge-case handling across multiple application types.
* CI/CD integration ownership: embedding automated tests into build/delivery pipelines and keeping them stable and trustworthy.
* Solid command of software testing principles and methodologies, with clear collaboration in a distributed, cross-functional team.
* Mobile test automation with Appium.
* Remote/cloud device and browser testing (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, or similar).
* SaaS, security, identity, privacy, or developer-facing product experience.
* Experience testing alongside and integrating with backend/API services.
* Mentoring junior automation engineers and reviewing test code.
* Experience working in global, distributed technical teams.
* Hands-on AI/ML experience beyond tooling (evaluating or applying AI-generated tests).

**Why Join Us**
This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
  
  
Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization & contribute to products used by customers around the world.
  
  
If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Relay Yard Automation, Relay Yard Automation
description:
**Description**
Amazon moves millions of packages daily through a global logistics network of Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers, and Delivery Stations. Every facility has a trailer yard — the physical space where line-haul vehicles arrive, get loaded or unloaded, and depart. Tracking what's happening in these yards in real time (which trailers are where, what state they're in, who's arriving and departing) is a hard problem that sits at the intersection of physical operations and software systems.
  
  
The Relay Yard Automation (RYA) team builds the software that manages these trailer yards across 6,000+ Amazon facilities on three continents. Our products handle 200K+ gate transactions
  
  
per day and facilitated the arrival and departure of 55M vehicles last year. We integrate computer vision, RFID, GPS, ultrasonic sensors, and IoT edge devices to automate what were historically manual, associate-staffed processes, from gate check-in/check-out to in-yard trailer movements. Our gate automation program has already eliminated millions of manual transactions, with a long-term goal of fully autonomous yard operations.
  
  
The tech stack is diverse by necessity: Android mobile apps for yard associates and drivers, React web applications for remote gate agents and yard operators, Java/TypeScript backend services on AWS, and hardware integrations running on edge compute devices deployed in the field. Systems are loosely coupled, event-driven, and must operate reliably in environments ranging from 1M+ sq ft North American fulfillment centers to small urban European delivery stations.
  
  
As an SDE on this team, you will design and build features and services that power yard automation across Amazon's logistics network. You will write high-quality code across the full stack, contribute to system design discussions, and deliver projects from technical design through production launch. The role involves working across backend services, web and mobile applications, and integrations with physical sensor systems at the edge. You will make thoughtful engineering trade-offs, participate in design and code reviews, and contribute to the team's operational excellence practices — supporting tier-1 systems where your work directly impacts driver experience and Amazon's ability to meet customer delivery promises.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement software for yard and gate automation products across tier-1 systems. Your code runs in production where defects directly impact driver experience and customer delivery promises.
* Lead large projects end-to-end: define the technical approach in ambiguous problem spaces, decompose work into parallel workstreams, and deliver cohesive launches.
* Own system architecture for your team's services. Proactively simplify code, resolve architecture deficiencies, and remove bottlenecks across Java backend services, TypeScript/React web apps, Android mobile apps, and IoT edge devices.
* Make short-term vs. long-term trade-off decisions and communicate them clearly to your team and stakeholders.
* Integrate with physical systems — RFID readers, computer vision cameras, ultrasonic sensors, GPS — running on edge compute in variable warehouse environments. Debug problems that span hardware and cloud software.
* Own operational excellence for services you build: monitoring, alarming, runbooks, incident response, and root-cause corrective actions.
* Influence technical direction beyond your team through design reviews with partner teams across Transportation Technology.
* Act as a force multiplier. Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design artifacts, and reusable frameworks. Mentor junior engineers toward their next level.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: IoT Engineer (Development & Implementation)
description:
**IoT Engineer (Development & Implementation)**

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a hands-on IoT Engineer with end-to-end expertise in designing, developing, and deploying scalable Internet of Things (IoT) solutions. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between physical hardware (sensors, actuators, edge gateways) and cloud/on-premise data platforms. You will be responsible for taking IoT initiatives from laboratory prototyping through to ruggedized field implementation across distributed sites.

**Key Responsibilities**

**● End-to-End Architecture:**
Design and build full-stack IoT architectures encompassing sensor nodes, edge computing gateways, communication networks, and central data ingestion pipelines.

**● Firmware & Edge Development:**
Write, test, and optimize embedded code and edge software (C/C++, Python, Embedded Linux) for microcontrollers and industrial gateways.

**● Protocol & Network Integration:**
Implement reliable device-to-cloud and device-to-device communication using industrial and IoT protocols (MQTT, CoAP, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC-UA, HTTP/HTTPS, LoRaWAN, BLE, or Cellular/4G/5G).

**● Field Deployment & Commissioning:**
Lead on-site installation, sensor calibration, gateway provisioning, and network troubleshooting across operational facilities.

**● Data Pipeline & Dashboarding:**
Integrate telemetry streams into time-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) and enterprise systems (ERP/SCADA/Cloud IoT cores), building real-time monitoring and alerting dashboards.

**● Security & Fleet Management:**
Implement device-level security (TLS/SSL, secure boot, encrypted credentials) and manage Over-The-Air (OTA) firmware updates for deployed fleets.

**● Reliability & Maintenance:**
Diagnose hardware failures, signal dropouts, and power-consumption bottlenecks in harsh or remote operating environments.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

● Education: B.Tech/B.E. in Electronics & Communication, Electrical, Instrumentation, Computer Science, or a related engineering field.

● Experience: 3–6+ years of demonstrable experience in full-cycle IoT development and field deployment (Industrial IoT/IIoT experience is highly preferred).

● Hardware Proficiency: Hands-on experience with MCUs/SoCs (ESP32, STM32, ARM Cortex), Single Board Computers (Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson, Industrial Edge PCs), and industrial PLCs/sensors.

● Software & Cloud: Proficiency in C/C++ and Python; experience with Docker at the edge, Linux administration, and IoT platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT, ThingsBoard, or custom self-hosted stacks).

● Tooling: Ability to use hardware debugging tools (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers) and schematic/PCB review tools.

title: Mobility Technology:  OBT Functional Testing Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Functional Testing Specialist to join the Mobility Technology / Digital Enablement team. The role will focus on manual testing of internal travel applications, particularly Online Booking Tools (OBTs) and integrated travel-technology platforms.
  
  
**Primary Objective**
Own end-to-end quality assurance for reservation platforms and help ensure reliable operation of corporate travel policy engines, air and hotel booking workflows, GDS/NDC integrations, payment gateways, and downstream systems.
  
  
**Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing. They will combine analytical thinking and attention to detail with effective cross-functional collaboration and a sound understanding of travel-domain processes. Prior travel-industry experience is preferred.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Test Planning and Design: Create, document, and maintain detailed manual test cases for internal travel applications, with particular emphasis on Online Booking Tools.
* Requirements Analysis: Understand travel business processes and translate business and technical requirements into clear, practical, and testable scenarios.
* Test Execution: Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, and end-to-end testing across releases and sprint cycles.
* Booking-Path Validation: Test complex, multi-tier booking journeys across air, hotel, rail, and car rental, including corporate travel policies, approval workflows, and profile synchronization.
* API and Integration Testing: Validate XML/JSON RESTful and SOAP integrations between the OBT and GDS platforms such as Sabre, Amadeus, and Travelport, as well as NDC aggregators and direct supplier connections.
* Payment and Downstream-System Validation: Verify corporate, virtual, and ghost-card processing and confirm accurate data transmission to mid-office, back-office, and expense-management systems, including SAP Concur and Chrome River.
* Defect Management: Identify, isolate, document, prioritize, and track defects in Azure DevOps or Jira, providing clear reproduction steps, appropriate severity levels, and supporting evidence.
* Retesting and Resolution: Collaborate with development teams to resolve defects and complete retesting to confirm that fixes work as expected.
* Delivery Planning: Estimate testing effort, identify risks, and support mitigation planning to enable timely, high-quality releases.
* Agile Delivery: Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, requirement discussions, development cycles, and retrospectives, providing timely quality-assurance input.
* Stakeholder Communication: Keep Product, Technology, and business stakeholders informed about testing progress, risks, blockers, quality concerns, and release readiness.
* Data Validation: Query databases to verify backend transaction states, profile-data mapping, and Passenger Name Record (PNR) generation.
* AI-Enabled Testing: Use AI tools where appropriate to support test-case creation, test-data preparation, defect analysis, and defect summarization.
* Continuous Improvement: Analyse user feedback and improve testing processes, documentation, test coverage, and overall quality-assurance practices.

**Must have**

* 6-8+ years of overall software testing experience.
* Strong hands-on experience in manual testing.
* 15 years of formal education.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proactive, curious and continuous-improvement mindset.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with AI, data analytics and digital technologies.
* Experience in UAT and working with cross-functional teams.
* Excellent attention to detail
* Ability to simplify complex themes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic understanding of the product development lifecycle.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology is a plus.
* Knowledge of tools such as Jira, Trello, Notion, Excel, or Google Sheets is preferred.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Eagerness to learn and take ownership of tasks.
* Basic understanding of UI/UX principles.
* Familiarity with SQL, analytics tools, or wireframing tools is an added advantage.

**Required Skills:**
The person in this role will need strong skills and experience in:
  
  

* 6 to 8 years of core software testing experience, with at least 5+ years dedicated to online tech platforms B2B and B2C
* Experience in a cross-border global role, successfully managing multiple complex projects at a global level
* Outstanding communication skills

**Optional/Preferred skills:**

* 3 to 6 years of core software testing experience, with at least 2+ years dedicated to travel-tech platforms, corporate travel booking engines, or OTA (Online Travel Agency) ecosystems.
* Experience or working knowledge of the travel domain, especially online booking applications and travel business processes.
* Understanding of the travel lifecycle, including PNR creation, ticketing, modifications, cancellations, refunds, void windows, and corporate travel policy configurations.
* proficiency with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, SoapUI).Solid hands-on experience using test management software (e.g., Jira/Zephyr, ALM, Azure DevOps).
* Intermediate proficiency in SQL for backend database verification (joins, indexing, basic data manipulation).
* Familiarity with web debugging tools (Chrome DevTools) to analyse network traffic, errors, and payloads.
* Conceptual understanding or basic exposure to automation testing frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, or RestAssured) to help transition manual workflows to automation.

**Certifications:**
ISTQB or equivalent software testing certification Preferred Not mandatory
  
  
**Work Experience:**
8-10 Years of end-to-end functional testing of any online B2C/B2B product preferably travel booking systems

title: Staff Engineer I, TSG Software Engineering
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

You’ll work as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build, and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale, browser-based or mobile applications, built with modern technology stacks and increasingly with AI-assisted and agent-assisted development, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

The Staff Engineer I is a senior individual contributor role that reports to the Engineering Manager. The role can independently handle a software module/function, which includes technical delivery, stakeholder management, and communication, and is accountable for the delivery outcomes of the wider team. The role is also responsible for aligning the technical delivery goals with product vision. The individual is also responsible for role modeling, and for coaching and mentoring of the team from a technical delivery standpoint.

  

**Technical Delivery (75%)**

* Provide module-level technical leadership on teams developing and updating enterprise-scale applications at Bain, and help drive the overall delivery outcomes of the team.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Take lead for the development of more complex components or functions with special requirements within a sprint. Understand the links between stories and desired outcomes and support the Engineering Manager and Product Owner with product strategy.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of business and domain. Support Product Owner and Engineering Manager in defining product roadmap and backlog by providing technical input.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories, perform task breakdown, and define technical approach and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule. Support junior team members in analyzing requirements and completion of technical tasks.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of using the underlying application development infrastructure.
* Help improve the infrastructure to optimize the application development.
* Contribute in the design, architecting, and prototyping of applications and significant application upgrades, primarily working with Engineering Managers, Architects, and Project/Product Managers.
* Apply AI-assisted development tools and AI agents responsibly to improve team productivity and code quality, and set the standard for how the team uses them.
* Champion secure software development practices, including secure use of AI-generated code, review of AI output, and protection of data and prompts.
* Own both development and testing: create the end-to-end test plan, execute it, and ensure zero-defect delivery.
* Prepare work estimates for committed components and support/review other team members’ estimates. Actively make recommendations to the other team members for their task allocations to promote skill diversity and growth.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion. In addition, review and support unit testing completed by other team members.
* Contribute to planning and participate in the testing and release of application releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support, and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills, e.g. creating automation tests, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/load testing, etc., through internal/external trainings to be a T-shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Help ensure adherence to Bain development project process and standards within the agile team as well as actively participating in the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* Write and review technical documentation prepared by the team.

**Research (10%)**

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Actively promote the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies, especially in Gen AI, LLMs, and AI agents, beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Lead the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team

  

**Communication (10%)**

* Clearly communicate and exchange ideas across multiple fronts, e.g., design, technical solutions.
* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during crucial conversations.
* Has strong listening skills to recognize needs of a team-member, and acts to deliver a great team experience.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.
* Provide feedback to Scrum Master, Engineering Manager, and Product Owner to improve team performance.
* Shares best practices across software group.

  

**Mentoring (5%)**

* Provide day to day technical guidance and mentoring to 1-3 less experienced engineers on the agile team.

  

**ABOUT YOU**

* 8–12 years in software engineering, including 2–3 years of technical leadership experience in owning complex modules, driving architecture decisions, and mentoring developers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Understanding of core architecture of the product and ability to suggest new technologies and approaches as per the product vision.
* Ability to deliver the assigned work independently with zero defects.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills.
* Experience developing enterprise-scale applications.
* Demonstrated record of T-shaped behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/contingencies.
* Experience providing technical leadership to a group of developers.
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

  

**Software Engineering – Technical Skills**

* AI and Gen AI: understanding of large language models (capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns), Gen AI application development, prompt engineering, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vectors, vector databases, machine learning fundamentals
* Secure development: secure software development practices, including for AI-driven development
* Backend languages and frameworks: Python, .NET and .NET Core, Java, or equivalent; C#, T-SQL, etc.
* Web frameworks/libraries: Angular, React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, etc.
* Architecture: scalable, secure, and maintainable system design; microservices, API design, and cloud-native patterns
* RDBMS: Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure services or equivalent
* Unit testing: xUnit, Jasmine, pytest, Jest, etc.
* Testing and quality: end-to-end test planning and execution, AI-enabled test automation, zero-defect delivery
* DevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines
* NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cosmos DB, etc.
* Caching: Redis, Memcached

Please note: we only build software. We do not handle anyone's money or give investment advice, and you will never be asked to trade or invest your own money.
  
  
Trendwick is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome everyone, whatever their gender, background or ability. Beware of fraud: we never ask for money for applications, training, joining or equipment. Report any such request to hr@trendwick.co or WhatsApp +971 58 307 6101.

title: Founding Member, Senior Innovation Engineer (Delhi NCR - Hybrid)
description:
**Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?**

J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.

The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enable clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.

**Job Description**

The Innovation Engineer rapidly turns high-value business opportunities into working Digital & AI solutions. This hands-on role designs, builds, integrates, and tests prototypes, agents, workflows, automations, and applications that can be evaluated with real users before the firm commits to larger-scale investment.

Working closely with Digital Solution Consultants, business subject-matter experts, and enterprise technology partners, the Innovation Engineer owns the technical execution of individual Foundry initiatives, from technical discovery and architecture through prototype development, iteration, feasibility validation, and transition planning. The role balances speed with sound engineering judgment and helps determine whether a concept can be delivered securely, responsibly, and at the appropriate level of scale.

This position also represents a unique opportunity to join as a founding member of our new Digital Innovation Foundry hub in New Delhi. As one of the hub's earliest team members, the Innovation Engineer will have the opportunity to help establish how the team operates, collaborates, and delivers innovative solutions while contributing to the growth of a new strategic capability for the firm.

J.S. Held is continuing to define the development technology stack, cloud patterns, environments, and CI/CD capabilities needed to support innovation at scale. As an early member of the Digital Innovation Foundry, the Innovation Engineer will partner closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, and other technology teams to help shape practical standards, reusable patterns, development environments, and delivery practices. The role requires a builder mindset, strong cloud development experience, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to distinguish rapid experimentation from production-ready engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Rapid Prototyping & Solution Development**

* Build functional prototypes, proofs of concept, agents, workflows, automations, integrations, and lightweight applications that allow opportunities to be tested with real users.
* Translate business problems, user journeys, requirements, and acceptance criteria into practical technical solutions in close partnership with Digital Solution Consultants.
* Use rapid, iterative development methods to incorporate user feedback and improve functionality, reliability, and usability.
* Select fit-for-purpose technologies and patterns for each experiment while considering speed, security, supportability, reuse, and the likely path to scale.
* Document technical assumptions, architecture decisions, dependencies, known limitations, and lessons learned so that decisions are transparent and reusable.
* Demonstrate working solutions to business and technical stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs in clear, decision-oriented language.

**AI, Agents & Automation Engineering**

* Design and build AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Azure services, and other approved technologies.
* Develop and evaluate AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation patterns, prompt and orchestration logic, knowledge grounding, tool use, workflow automation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Integrate solutions with enterprise data, content, APIs, applications, and identity services while following approved access and security patterns.
* Evaluate solution quality, grounding, accuracy, reliability, performance, cost, and failure modes using test cases appropriate to the use case.
* Build reusable components, connectors, templates, and patterns where they can accelerate multiple initiatives and reduce fragmented point solutions.
* Identify when a low-code, configuration-based, custom-development, or existing-platform approach is most appropriate.

**Cloud, Architecture & Technical Feasibility**

* Design and develop cloud-based solutions in Microsoft Azure.
* Conduct technical discovery and feasibility assessment covering architecture, data, integrations, identity and access, security, privacy, performance, scalability, observability, support, and cost.
* Partner with IT and Enterprise Architecture to define appropriate solution patterns and clarify the boundary between rapid Foundry experimentation and enterprise production delivery.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and constraints early and recommend whether an initiative should proceed, be redesigned, transition to an enterprise team, or stop.
* Contribute technical estimates and delivery options to initiative-level business cases and scale decisions.
* Ensure prototypes use representative data responsibly and do not create unsupported production dependencies or unmanaged technical risk.

**Engineering Foundations & Delivery Practices**

* Partner with IT to help establish the development technology stack, source-control approach, environments, infrastructure patterns, deployment methods, and engineering guardrails for the Foundry.
* Help define and mature CI/CD practices for prototypes and solutions, recognizing that these capabilities are still being established rather than assuming mature pipelines already exist.
* Apply sound software engineering practices including modular design, version control, code review, automated testing, documentation, dependency management, secrets management, and secure configuration.
* Work with IT to define practical development, test, quality-assurance, and production pathways appropriate to solution complexity and risk.
* Implement monitoring, logging, usage telemetry, and cost visibility where appropriate to support evaluation and future supportability.
* Prepare validated solutions for transition by documenting architecture, code, configuration, data flows, deployment needs, operational requirements, and known risks.

**Collaboration, Reuse & Scale**

* Work closely with Digital Solution Consultants and business users throughout discovery, piloting, testing, and iteration rather than treating development as a downstream handoff.
* Collaborate with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Legal, Compliance, and other partners to incorporate enterprise requirements at the appropriate stage.
* Provide initiative-level technical progress, feasibility findings, risks, cost considerations, and recommendations to support portfolio reviews and investment decisions.
* Contribute reusable technical standards, reference implementations, templates, and playbooks to strengthen the Foundry operating model.
* Mentor non-engineering team members on technical possibilities, constraints, and responsible experimentation, and support knowledge transfer to teams that assume ownership of successful solutions.
* · Stay current on relevant AI, cloud, automation, and development capabilities, and evaluate emerging tools based on business fit rather than novelty.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud application development, solution engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering, or a related field, including hands-on responsibility for designing and delivering working solutions.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience developing AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Azure AI services, or closely comparable enterprise platforms.
* Strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Python, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript, with experience building APIs, services, integrations, and user-facing applications.
* Hands-on cloud development experience in Microsoft Azure is required; experience across multiple cloud providers, including Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud, is strongly preferred.
* Experience with cloud architecture, APIs, event-driven or serverless patterns, identity and access management, data stores, enterprise integrations, monitoring, and secure application design.
* Experience with AI application patterns such as agents, retrieval-augmented generation, model and prompt orchestration, grounding, evaluation, tool use, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Experience establishing or improving development foundations, including source control, branching, automated testing, environments, infrastructure as code, deployment automation, and CI/CD practices.
* Ability to prototype rapidly while making clear distinctions between experimental code and production-ready solutions, including the risks and work required to transition between them.
* · Working knowledge of security, privacy, responsible AI, data governance, resiliency, performance, cost management, observability, and production support considerations.
* · Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain architecture choices and technical trade-offs to business leaders, subject-matter experts, architects, engineers, and risk partners.
* · Experience in professional services, consulting, or another expert-led, knowledge-intensive environment is beneficial.
* · Self-directed builder mindset with the ability to create structure in an evolving environment, partner constructively with enterprise IT, and balance delivery speed with reusable and supportable engineering practices

We welcome applications from individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable adjustment in relation to any of the above, please email jobs@jsheld.com and include “Applicant Adjustment” within the subject line with your request and contact information.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Delhi
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**
Experience: 4-6 Years
  
  
**About the Company:**
Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines
* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus)
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT)
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona)
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Engineer 3 - Business Systems
description:

The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable business systems. The team continuously evolves the CRM and marketing technology ecosystem through automation, integrations, data quality improvements, and platform operations.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an Engineer III, Business Systems to design, build, and support the systems and integrations that enable MongoDB’s top-of-funnel and lead-to-revenue processes.
  
  
This individual contributor role will focus on marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, enrichment, campaign operations, account and territory management, activity management, outreach, annual planning, and inbound and outbound integrations. You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services.
  
  
You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes
* Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities

* Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps

**Responsibilities**
Technical Delivery
  
  

* Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms.

Marketing Technology Engineering
  
  

* Own and enhance capabilities across:

+ Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing
+ Marketing enrichment and data normalization
+ Campaign and campaign member management
+ Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management
+ Territory planning and account assignment
+ Activity and engagement management
+ Outreach and business development workflows
+ Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting
+ Annual planning and operational planning processes

Integration and System Design
  
  

* Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms.

Data Quality and Governance
  
  

* Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data.

Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns.

Platform Optimization
  
  

* Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience
* Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation
* Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services
* Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks
* Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support
* Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions

* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: Test Strategy & Operations Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT)
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions.The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As the Test Strategy & Operations Management Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT) (f/m/d), you start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.
* Lead and govern defined UAT test-related activities across the global rollout program.
* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

**What You Bring**
Proven experience in managing IT environments or transformation programs.
  
  

* Good understanding of enterprise IT systems (software, hardware, databases).
* Experience in rollout initiatives (preferably SAP/S/4HANA).
* Knowledge of IT operations, governance, and service management structures.
* Experience to work with external IT partners and related performance frameworks.
* Experience leading cross-functional, international initiatives.
* Business fluent English; German is an advantage

**About The Team (Vision/Mission Of The UAT Team)**
You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Gain deep insights into the most strategic Business / IT Transformation Program of Siemens Energy
* Get a profound understanding of the global Siemens Energy organization, process landscape and ways of working
* Establish a wide personal network with stakeholders and colleagues from all Businesses, Regions and Functions as well as with internal and external partners
* All employees are automatically covered under Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay monthly.

title: Senior Manager Quality Engineering
description:
**Role:**
Senior Manager, Quality Engineering

**Function:**
Quality Engineering / Software Testing

**Location:**
Gurugram or Kolkata

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Technology

**About Company**

The company builds AI-powered SaaS for the U.S. dental market.

Its platform unifies analytics, communications, scheduling, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of solo practices, group practices, and DSOs rely on it daily.

It is a profitable SaaS business approaching eight figures in revenue. The company is mission-driven and execution-oriented — quality is designed in, not inspected in at the end.

If you want to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical and see clear, measurable impact, this is the place.

**Position Overview**

This role leads a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers and owns the modernization of how quality is built into the company's products. The mandate is to increase release confidence faster than QA headcount grows — through automation engineering, AI-assisted workflows, production observability, and shared quality ownership across Engineering, Product, and DevOps. This is a hands-on technical leadership position: the person in this role personally writes and reviews automation code, designs testing architecture, and investigates difficult production issues.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Establish a modern quality-engineering operating model based on shared ownership across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Quality Engineering; define risk-based testing strategies for critical customer workflows, integrations, and platforms.
* Own the architecture and evolution of web, API, integration, and end-to-end automation — personally build and maintain production-quality code in Playwright and TypeScript, including reusable libraries, fixtures, test-data systems, and parallel execution infrastructure.
* Integrate high-signal suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent); treat flaky and noisy tests as engineering defects and continuously improve execution speed, stability, and diagnosability.
* Define testing and evaluation strategies for AI assistants, call intelligence, and automated conversation workflows — build repeatable evaluations covering accuracy, hallucination risk, context retention, fallback logic, unsafe output, privacy, and latency.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents in daily engineering workflows across test design, automation development, code review, debugging, and incident analysis; establish practical AI-assisted workflows for the team and measure their impact on development time, maintenance effort, and release-validation speed.
* Investigate production and pre-production issues using SQL, logs, traces, API requests, browser developer tools, and monitoring platforms; lead root-cause analyses that address the architectural, testing, or observability gap that allowed a defect to escape.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers through clear goals, direct feedback, performance reviews, hiring, and career growth — raising the technical bar while scaling quality through better systems rather than linear headcount.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 8+ years in software quality, test automation, or quality engineering, including 3+ years of people leadership managing and developing engineers.
* 4+ years of hands-on automation experience; personally written, reviewed, debugged, and maintained production automation code within the last 12 months.
* Strong software engineering ability in TypeScript or JavaScript; experience designing automation systems from the ground up, not only scripting within an existing framework.
* Strong experience with Playwright for browser automation and API testing; candidates from Selenium or Cypress must demonstrate current coding ability and a track record of modernizing legacy automation architecture.
* Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent) and improving execution reliability, speed, and diagnosability.
* Practical, current use of AI coding assistants or agents — able to describe specific workflows, measurable benefits, limitations encountered, and a concrete case where AI output was confidently wrong and how it was caught.
* Strong production-debugging skills using SQL, logs, traces, observability systems, and network-level tooling; demonstrated track record of improving quality without proportional growth in manual QA headcount.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience testing AI assistants, LLM-powered products, conversational systems, call intelligence, or automated communication workflows.
* Background in healthcare SaaS, dental technology, VoIP, payments, or other business-critical platforms.
* Experience with mobile automation, distributed architectures, third-party integrations, and asynchronous processing.
* Exposure to performance, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, or observability testing.
* Track record of transforming a traditional QA team into a modern Quality Engineering organization.

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of a high-impact, technically ambitious quality engineering mandate at a profitable, product-led SaaS company.
* Direct influence on architecture, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering practices across a cross-functional team.
* Autonomy and flexible scheduling within a mission-driven, execution-oriented culture.
* Opportunity to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical with clear, measurable customer impact.
* Support for technical growth, career development, and contribution as a genuine engineering partner — not a process gatekeeper.

title: DevSecOps Engineer, IE&O
description:
**Position Title:**
DevSecOps Engineer, IE&O
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
45078
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The DevSecOps Engineer is a senior hands-on engineering role within the Enterprise Infrastructure Platform Engineering team. The role designs, implements, secures, and operates resilient cloud infrastructure and enterprise DevSecOps platforms, with a strong focus on automation, developer enablement, governance, reliability, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and also Google Cloud, the engineer partners with platform architects, security, application, data, and AI teams to embed security, quality, observability, and change controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. The role also advances responsible use of generative and agentic AI in infrastructure-as-code and engineering workflows, supported by appropriate guardrails, human oversight, and FinOps discipline.
  
  
Success in this role means: secure-by-design platforms, reliable automated delivery, faster developer flow, auditable change, and reduced operational toil.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Platform Engineering & Reliability:**
Design, implement, and monitor secure, fault-tolerant, highly available cloud infrastructure and DevSecOps platform services.
  
  
**CI/CD & Release Engineering:**
Establish and continuously improve build, test, release, and deployment frameworks that support scalable delivery, traceability, auditability, and repeatability.
  
  
**DevSecOps Adoption:**
Drive adoption of DevSecOps and cloud platform capabilities across application, data, and AI engineering teams through reusable patterns, enablement, and technical guidance.
  
  
**Security by Design:**
Embed SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, secrets management, policy enforcement, and security quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
**Infrastructure as Code:**
Build and maintain modular, tested, and governed infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, and related tooling.
  
  
**GitOps & Kubernetes:**
Implement GitOps-based delivery and lifecycle management for container platforms using technologies such as Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, Argo CD, Flux CD, Helm, Docker, and Podman.
  
  
**Toolchain Availability:**
Engineer and operate reliable services supporting source control, artifact management, containerization, continuous integration, release management, change management, and developer workflows.
  
  
**Automated Governance:**
Integrate automated change-management controls, approvals, evidence capture, policy-as-code, and promotion controls across development-to-production pipelines.
  
  
**Observability & Self-Healing:**
Integrate metrics, logs, traces, event analytics, and automated remediation to improve service health, troubleshooting, performance, and resilience.
  
  
**Performance & Operations:**
Lead technical analysis, optimization, incident response, problem resolution, upgrade planning, operational readiness, and lifecycle management for DevOps infrastructure.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Architecture:**
Translate development, security, operations, reliability, and compliance requirements into implementable platform designs and engineering standards.
  
  
**AI-Assisted Engineering:**
Apply generative and agentic AI to accelerate infrastructure engineering and automation while maintaining human oversight, security guardrails, governance, and cost accountability.
  
  
**Documentation & Enablement:**
Produce clear technical documentation, reference architectures, standards, runbooks, and reusable implementation guidance; coach teams on engineering best practices.
  
  
**Automation Culture:**
Identify repetitive manual processes and replace them with secure, supportable, observable automation.
  
  
**Required Skills And Experience**
Core Experience
  
  
**10+ years of relevant experience**
in DevSecOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, task automation, or GitOps.
  
  
**Hands-on engineering experience**
designing and operating enterprise-scale CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, container platforms, and automation frameworks.

using Python, Bash, PowerShell, Groovy, Java, C#, C++, or comparable languages.

across incident response, problem management, performance analysis, upgrade execution, high availability, and technical documentation.

with the ability to work effectively across architecture, security, infrastructure, application, data, and AI teams.

is preferred.

title: Technology consultant/ Fractional CTO
description:
**We're Hiring: Technology Consultant / Fractional CTO**

**Engineering Hiring | Technology Architecture | Strategic Advisory**

📍 
**Location:**
 Gurgaon, Haryana / Remote

💼 
**Engagement:**
 Paid Consulting / Contract / Fractional Advisory

🎯 
**Experience:**
 8+ years preferred (strong technical expertise takes priority over years of experience)

🚀 
**Opportunity:**
 Initial project-based engagement with potential for a long-term advisory partnership

**About Aumraa**

At 
**Aumraa**
, we're on a mission to build India's next-generation 
**Devotional Super App**
 — a unified faith-tech ecosystem that brings together temples, pujas, spiritual guidance, devotional content, sacred commerce and community, with a vision to become a trusted digital companion for millions of devotees.

As an early-stage startup, we're establishing our in-house technology team and laying the foundation for a scalable digital platform spanning web, mobile applications, commerce, service bookings and integrations.

**About the Opportunity**

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on 
**Technology Consultant / Fractional CTO / Engineering Leader**
 to work closely with our founder and help us make informed technical decisions as we build Aumraa.

**Our immediate priority is to hire Full-Stack Developers**
, and we need an experienced technology professional who can independently assess candidates, lead technical evaluations and help us build a capable engineering team.

Beyond recruitment, we envision this evolving into a long-term technology advisory relationship, supporting our platform architecture, mobile application development, engineering standards and broader technology initiatives.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys working with early-stage startups, combining hands-on technical expertise with strategic thinking and helping founders translate ambitious product visions into reliable, scalable technology. Engagement Structure

**This is not a conventional full-time CTO position OR Co-founder position.**
We are initially seeking an independent technology consultant for a defined, paid technical hiring engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Hiring & Candidate Evaluation — Immediate Priority**

* Review and refine technical job descriptions, skill requirements and evaluation criteria for Senior and Junior Full-Stack Developer positions.
* Design and conduct structured technical interviews covering Java, Spring Boot, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, databases and API development.
* Evaluate candidates on coding proficiency, debugging, problem-solving, system design, security fundamentals and real-world development experience.
* Develop practical technical assessments appropriate to each experience level.
* Assess candidates' ability to independently develop, maintain and deploy production-ready applications.
* Provide structured candidate scorecards, comparative assessments and clear hiring recommendations.
* Advise on engineering team structure, role ownership and technical competency expectations.

**2. Technology Architecture & Strategic Advisory — Longer-Term Scope**

* Review Aumraa's existing technology stack and recommend improvements where necessary.
* Advise on backend architecture, frontend architecture, database design, API standards and third-party integrations.
* Evaluate and recommend the appropriate mobile application framework, including React Native versus Flutter.
* Guide architectural decisions involving scalability, performance, security, maintainability and cost efficiency.
* Recommend infrastructure, cloud deployment, CI/CD, monitoring and development practices suited to an early-stage technology company.
* Help establish a practical technical roadmap aligned with Aumraa's product development priorities.
* Identify architectural risks, technical debt and potential implementation bottlenecks before they become costly.

**3. Engineering Guidance & Development Oversight — Ongoing Advisory Scope**

* Provide periodic technical guidance and mentorship to Aumraa's in-house engineering team.
* Review critical code, architecture decisions and implementation approaches.
* Help establish coding standards, code review practices, testing expectations and documentation guidelines.
* Advise on technical task breakdown, development estimates and engineering milestones.
* Review development progress and help resolve complex technical challenges.
* Support technical evaluations of external vendors, integrations and technology partners when required.
* Act as a trusted technology advisor to the founder on important engineering decisions.

**Technical Expertise Required**

* **Strong hands-on expertise in:**
* **Backend:**

   Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, RESTful APIs, authentication and authorisation.
* **Frontend:**

   React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript and modern frontend architecture.
* **Databases:**

   Relational database design, SQL, data modelling and performance optimisation.
* **Architecture:**

   System design, modular architecture, API integration, scalability and secure application development.
* **Engineering Practices:**

   Git, testing, code reviews, CI/CD and production deployment.
* **Security:**

   Application security, secure coding principles, access controls and data protection.

**Additional experience that would be valuable:**

* React Native and/or Flutter mobile application development.
* AWS, Azure, GCP or equivalent cloud infrastructure.
* Shopify, e-commerce integrations and third-party commerce platforms.
* Payment gateways, booking systems, notifications and service-oriented platform integrations.
* Experience designing or scaling consumer-facing web and mobile products.

*Expertise in our core Java/Spring Boot and React stack is essential. Direct experience with every additional technology is not mandatory.*

**Who We're Looking For**

* An experienced professional who:
* Has preferably 
  **8+ years of software engineering experience**

  , including substantial hands-on development and architecture responsibilities.
* Has worked as a CTO, Fractional CTO, Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, Solution Architect, Principal Engineer or Senior Full-Stack Engineer.
* Has personally built, shipped or scaled production-grade digital products.
* Can evaluate both junior and senior engineering candidates with confidence.
* Has experience mentoring developers and establishing practical engineering standards.
* Understands the challenges, resource constraints and decision-making needs of an early-stage startup.
* Can communicate complex technical decisions clearly to a non-technical founder.
* Takes a pragmatic, business-oriented approach rather than recommending unnecessarily complex technology solutions.
* Is comfortable working independently and providing objective technical recommendations.
* Experience advising startups or building engineering teams from the ground up will be a strong advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

**During the initial engagement:**

* Clear technical evaluation criteria for the two Full-Stack Developer positions.
* Well-structured interviews and practical assessments.
* Objective, documented candidate evaluations.
* Confident hiring recommendations supported by technical evidence.
* Clear expectations for each developer's responsibilities and capabilities.

**As the relationship develops:**

* A well-defined, scalable technology architecture.
* Informed decisions about our mobile framework and supporting infrastructure.
* Improved engineering quality and technical accountability.
* A capable in-house development team supported by consistent technical guidance.

Based on mutual fit, availability and business requirements, the engagement may subsequently expand into a longer-term, fractional technology advisory relationship.

We welcome applications from independent consultants, fractional CTOs and experienced engineering leaders offering consulting services.

**Location:**
 Remote engagement is welcome. Gurgaon-based professionals are also encouraged to apply.

**Compensation:**
 Competitive consulting fees, based on relevant experience and the agreed scope of work.

**How to Apply**

If you have strong engineering expertise, enjoy solving real-world technology challenges and would like to help an ambitious startup build its engineering foundation, we'd love to connect.
