title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
description:
**Description**
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
  
  
The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume + complex business rules in a highly distributed and service-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
  
  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
  
  
**A Day In The Life**
You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.
* Responsible for CI/CD pipelines and suggest ways to improve the code delivery process.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
**Our DTS Team Provides Following Services To Clients**

* Data & Applied Intelligence - Helping clients in harnessing the power of data and cutting-edge analytics to drive intelligent decision-making and transform businesses.
* Product and Innovation - Empowering clients to innovate, develop, and launch products that drives growth and competitive advantage.
* Technology M&A and Strategy - Assist clients to manage the technology aspects and business enablement of complex M&A, integrations and carve-outs.
* Technology Transformation - A&M helps clients create a scalable, cost-effective IT function that delivers the company's strategic vision and priorities.

**How You Will Contribute**

* Build the evaluation framework used to determine whether an AI application is fit to go live, covering component, trajectory and end-to-end outcome measurement, with defined pass thresholds integrated into the delivery pipeline.
* Work directly with business subject-matter experts to define correct outcomes and convert them into maintained benchmark datasets.
* Design and calibrate automated judging, validating it against human review so that reported scores are meaningful and defensible.
* Own repeatable adversarial testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, guardrail bypass and data leakage, and rerun the suite after every material model or prompt change.
* Implement runtime safety controls, including content filtering, sensitive-data redaction, tool permissions, spend caps and circuit breakers.
* Instrument applications so quality, latency, tokens and model cost are observable per request, application and tenant.
* Own model-cost optimisation through routing, caching and prompt efficiency, using evaluation evidence to demonstrate when a lower-cost model is sufficient.
* Monitor production quality and drift, maintain a failure taxonomy, and feed observed failures back into benchmark datasets.
* Validate model upgrades before cutover so vendor model changes do not degrade client-facing systems.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in software, data or AI/ML engineering, with strong Python capability and hands-on experience building production-grade agentic or LLM applications for real users using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, tool calling and retrieval.
* Demonstrable experience designing AI evaluations and measuring retrieval quality, including defining measures and scoring methods, assessing groundedness and relevance, diagnosing failures, distinguishing genuine regressions from noise, and running online evaluations over sampled production traces.
* Practical experience implementing model-safety controls and adversarial testing, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, data leakage, filtering, redaction, guardrails, spend limits and loop controls.
* Experience accessing and deploying models across multiple providers, understanding cost, latency and capability trade-offs, and working with self-hosted or open-weight models, fine-tuning, distillation or prompt optimisation.

description:

As an IT Test Automation Engineer, you will strengthen enterprise testing and quality engineering capabilities across global SAP and business application landscapes. You will also drive ongoing validation and quality assurance to ensure that deployed automation remains effective, efficient, compliant, and aligned with business requirements throughout its lifecycle, including monitoring automation quality, reviewing test assets, validating execution results, and driving continuous improvement of testing processes.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Review and validate automation scripts, test cases, test data, and execution strategies.
* Ensure compliance with established automation standards, naming conventions, and development guidelines, and define and continuously improve quality standards for automated testing.
* Conduct quality reviews of automation assets and automation frameworks, assess automation coverage, and identify opportunities to expand automation adoption.
* Establish controls to ensure consistency and reusability of test assets across projects and verify traceability between requirements, business processes, test cases, and execution results.
* Drive continuous improvement of testing methodologies and test automation practices.
* Ensure secure, compliant, reliable, and lifecycle-oriented operation of the Test Automation Service (SSO).
* Coordinate service governance and manage operational, technical, and compliance risks while maintaining service documentation and controls.

title: Senior QA/SDET Specialist
description:
**About Us**

Hero FinCorp Group is building HomeVerse, India’s first fully digital home ownership ecosystem. We are building a high-quality technology organization with strong engineering foundations, modern architecture, and a product mindset focused on speed, reliability, and scale.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Senior QA/SDET Specialist to build and own a modern quality engineering capability across web, mobile, backend, APIs, and data-driven workflows. The role requires a hands-on engineer who can define test strategy, build automation frameworks, improve release confidence, and embed quality into the software development lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and drive the end-to-end quality strategy across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, mobile applications, and critical user journeys.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks with strong emphasis on reliability, maintainability, and execution speed.
* Own functional, regression, integration, API, end-to-end, and where relevant performance and security testing approaches.
* Embed automated quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and establish clear release readiness and defect triage standards.
* Partner closely with product managers, engineers, and DevOps teams to identify risks early and shift quality practices left in the development lifecycle.
* Develop reusable test utilities, test data strategies, mocks, service virtualization, and environment management practices.
* Analyze flaky tests, production defects, and escaped issues to identify systemic root causes and improve engineering quality.
* Define meaningful quality metrics covering defect leakage, automation effectiveness, release stability, test coverage, and execution health.

* Experience testing distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, third-party integrations, and failure/recovery scenarios.
* Working knowledge of SQL and database validation for end-to-end testing.
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to work directly with engineers on production-quality issues.

* Experience with performance testing using k6, JMeter, Gatling, or equivalent.
* Experience with mobile automation using Appium, Detox, Espresso, or XCUITest.
* Experience testing cloud-native, microservices, or event-driven architectures.
* Experience in fintech, lending, payments, or other transaction-heavy and regulated products.
* Experience with observability tools and production monitoring to support quality validation and incident analysis.

**What This Role Offers**

The opportunity to establish a modern quality engineering culture, build automation capabilities from first principles, and materially improve the speed and confidence with which the organization ships software

* Mentorship & Influence: Proven track record of guiding junior engineers, driving engineering consensus across disparate teams, and leading technical initiatives without direct authority.
* Observability & Reliability: Hands-on experience with modern observability platforms, distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana ecosystems, and enterprise SRE practices.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions

The role assists with risk and control governance forums, develops meaningful metrics and executive reporting, communicates risk themes and issue status to senior management, and escalates matters requiring timely decisions or intervention. The role also coordinates regulatory assessments and responses, client reviews, and SOC/SOX activities, supports the Privacy team as needed, and provides leadership, coaching, and quality oversight to ensure work is completed in accordance with department and industry standards.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**
The Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory, leads the planning and execution of issue validation and control testing to confirm remediation addresses root causes and delivers sustainable outcomes. The role, as a risk advisor, partners with business and technology leaders to identify and assess emerging risks, shape risk strategies, clarify risk acceptance decisions, and align remediation priorities with enterprise standards and business objectives. The role strengthens the control environment by advising on control design, evaluating design and operating effectiveness, maintaining accurate risk and control inventories, identifying thematic gaps and trends, and driving clear ownership, monitoring, and timely remediation. The role also supports effective governance by facilitating risk and control forums, establishing meaningful metrics and reporting, communicating risk themes and issue status to senior management, and escalating matters requiring timely decisions or intervention. It coordinates regulatory assessments and responses, client reviews, and SOC/SOX activities across Global Technology and Operations, and supports the Privacy team with privacy-related risk assessments, incident response, data mapping, and privacy-by-design activities.
  
  

* Lead issue validation and testing engagements to confirm that root causes are addressed and remediation is sustainable.
* Plan and schedule validation reviews for open issues, prioritizing work based on risk, target closure dates, and validation readiness.
* Coordinate validation activities with issue owners, control design functions, First Line management, and Audit to confirm scope, evidence requirements, dependencies, and review timelines.
* Assess remediation evidence and control implementation to determine whether corrective actions address root causes and operate as intended.
* Track validation progress, resolve evidence gaps, and escalate delays or risks that could affect timely issue closure.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to assess technology, cyber, data, resilience, and third-party risks; shape risk strategies; and align risk acceptance and remediation decisions with enterprise standards and business objectives.
* Lead risk assessments, maintain accurate process, risk, control, and issue inventories, and analyze trends and control gaps to strengthen control design, monitoring, remediation, governance, and reporting.
* Coordinate responses to risk events and emerging issues with business, Technology, Legal, Compliance, and control partners; provide executive reporting and escalation; facilitate root-cause and after-action reviews; and track corrective actions through sustainable resolution.
* Remain current on industry developments in cybersecurity, cloud, DevOps, information security, third-party risk management, and resilience.
* Lead and execute engagements that meet the department’s methodologies and quality standards.
* Invest in professional development, educate others on key risks and controls, and support staff development, recruiting, performance management, and succession planning.
* Leverage data analytics and develop review programs to support risk assessments, review design, and testing of key GTO risks.
* Guide the team on continuous monitoring, year-over-year review coverage, aggregation of key issues for senior leadership, and stakeholder governance meetings.
* Support the Privacy team, as needed, with incident response and escalation, awareness activities, Privacy Impact Assessments, data mapping, and privacy-by-design engagement with Technology Product Owners.
* Lead and support regulatory gap assessments and responses, SOC/SOX activities, and client assessments in partnership with Technology, business, Legal, Compliance, and Audit stakeholders.

**What You Will Bring**

* 8+ years of relevant experience gained through a combination of information security/technology, risk and/or audit related roles, including leading complex engagements and managing multiple concurrent deliverables. Specifically, experience in cloud operations, cyber security operations, vulnerability management or other IT operation-based specialist roles.
* Demonstrated expertise in the intricacies associated with a global company and its information technology/cyber security risk profile, including expanding regulatory requirements
* Strong knowledge of emerging topics and current analytical methods and techniques used to monitor and manage relevant risks.
* Track record of supervising, coaching, and developing talent; experience with work planning, staffing, and reviewing team deliverables for quality and consistency. Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience communicating complex topics to senior management and driving alignment on issues, ownership, and remediation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to leverage data, metrics, and analytics to inform scoping, testing strategy, and thematic insights.
* Executive level communication skills, both oral and written, and the ability to partner effectively with multiple business groups, corporate areas, and second and third lines teams.
* Bachelor’s degree related to technology, risk management, finance, or other quantitative fields of study

**What will set you apart?**

* Experience in leveraging and/or performing data analysis in support of internal auditing.
* Advanced degrees in information technology or cyber security are preferred: An MBA, CIA, CISA, CISSP and/or designations/certifications (e.g., AI, AWS Cloud Practitioner) that demonstrate proficiency in information technology, information security, and/or cyber security related risks and controls is a plus.
* PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, FinTech Tax
description:
**Description**
Amazon is looking for a leaders to build next generation tax systems that powers billions of dollars of accurate payments across multiple lines of business worldwide. Amazon is seeking a rock star Software Development Engineer who will own, architect and shape the future of our FinTech Tax Technology with capabilities to process withholding taxes applicable on invoices and making related payments, provide financial data integration and process global tax requirements across Amazon.
  
  
Can you work at the scale of the biggest Internet companies?
  
  
The solutions that you will build must scale to accommodate rapid processing and integration with large enterprise customers. However, to add to the challenge, the solutions must also support integration with highly scaled systems.
  
  
Are you ready to create best in class taxation systems to expand one of the world’s largest e-commerce engines?
  
  
If so, come be a member of Amazon’s FinTech Tax Technology team. FinTech Tax Tech builds software systems that ensure compliance for Amazon's global businesses and its subsidiaries and makes it easy for millions of Amazon vendors including publishers, app developers, game developers, marketplace sellers, associates and others to comply for hundreds of billions of dollars in transactions. The software platform is among the largest in the world by volume and complexity handling billions of dollars of payments. Much of our work enables Amazon’s new market or business model launches and happens as part of these enterprise programs. We partner integrally with the CFO organization worldwide, including the central finance functions and line of business leadership. We're constantly looking for opportunities to expand capabilities in new geographies and new lines of business.
  
  
Is your next project defining a world class Internet service?
  
  
With us, you will be architecting and delivering applications and services in an environment of highly distributed systems used by Amazon Tax teams. Your innovation will provide new functionality for millions of vendors/payees/sellers globally with a goal of making it easy to comply with tax regulations. You shift your experiences from working at the peripheries of the systems to actually start designing their cores.
  
  
Do you want to define the future of Internet commerce?
  
  
Are you a top-notch software engineer with a creative flare, strong problem-solving skills, the drive to build and ship products often, a solid computer science foundation, and the desire to build Amazon's next generation financial systems architecture to enable 100+ Amazon businesses across Retail, AWS, Physical Stores, Corporates and many more? Come talk with us about joining our customer obsessed team as we expand our capabilities in new geographies and newer lines of business.
  
  
Are you up for overcoming challenges in an highly entrepreneurial environment?
  
  
Enabling Amazon’s explosive growth requires top talent in our FinTech Tax Technology organization. We are seeking Sr. Software Development Engineers who will drive next generation architectural and design choices, invent new features, develop distributed services, keep financial data secure, and build a scalable, service-oriented and performance oriented platform for our customers.
  
  
A successful candidate will be a role model to set an example for building strong and highly-effective teams you can trust, provide direction and guidance to other engineers in the team while you own the critical path of the architecture, work collaboratively with your customers, and deliver extensible, scalable, resilient, serverless, and secure architecture. As you charter unchartered areas, you embrace ambiguity to innovate with bold bets to drive business growth through technology. You continually solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context aligning your team’s work, goals and priorities with Amazon’s business objectives. You will build flexible systems and processes without over-engineering and choose simple, straightforward solutions over more complex ones.
  
  
We are seeking someone who has passion for learning, excellent in communication and out-of-box thinker with a can-do attitude and a focus on delivering high quality software. We move at a fast pace and deliver software iteratively using agile best practices and the latest technologies.
  
  
We have a team culture that encourages innovation and we expect engineers and management alike to take a high level of ownership for the product vision, technical architecture and project delivery.
  
  
Join our development team to work hard, have fun and make history. You will join a highly technical and entrepreneurial culture defining and building a taxation experience to complement Amazon’s world-class eCommerce domains. Amazon is a premier place to build, deploy and operate internet-scale services.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

* Hunt down technical debt — dead automations, bloated triggers, redundant fields, and queries that scan half the database for one record.
* Audit and rationalize automations into a single, sane framework. No more “which of the five automations on this object actually fires first?” mysteries.
* Monitor org health proactively — governor limits, storage, API consumption, deployment stability — using Salesforce Optimizer, Event Monitoring, and custom dashboards you build yourself.

**Development & Code Quality**

* Build production-grade Apex — bulkified, governor-limit-aware, single-trigger-per-object, with proper separation of concerns (service/selector/domain layers).
* Develop Lightning Web Components that are reusable, accessible
* Hold the quality bar in code reviews — meaningful test assertions (not just coverage farming), no hardcoded IDs, clean error handling, sensible naming.
* Own and improve the CI/CD pipeline — scratch orgs, source-driven development, automated test gates, and deployments that don’t need a war room.

**Integration & Data Management**

* Design and maintain integrations via REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture — with proper retry logic, error handling, and idempotency.
* Champion data quality — deduplication strategies, validation rules that actually help, and migration practices that don’t create a cleanup project of their own.
* Troubleshoot sync failures and API limit issues across connected systems before they become someone’s escalation.

**Collaboration & Best Practices Enablement**

* Define and document development standards and best practices — then make sure the team actually follows them.
* Mentor junior developers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing — not lectures.
* Evaluate every Salesforce release (three per year) for features worth adopting and deprecations worth addressing.
* Help the team make smart clicks-vs-code decisions so the org stays maintainable as it grows.

****Qualifications****
**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Deep hands-on skills in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, LWC, and enough Visualforce knowledge to maintain legacy components.
* Strong JavaScript/ES6+, HTML, and CSS fundamentals.
* Expertise in Salesforce’s security architecture — profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, FLS, OWDs, role hierarchy.
* Solid Git workflow habits — branching, pull requests, merge conflict resolution.
* Proficiency with Salesforce CLI, scratch orgs, metadata API, and at least one CI/CD tool (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset).
* Sharp debugging instincts — Debug Logs, Query Plan tool, Limit monitoring, and the patience to trace a bug through five layers of automation.
* Familiarity with data migration/ETL tools — Data Loader, Dataloader.io, or equivalent.
* Comfortable in Agile/Scrum rhythms without needing a ceremony for every decision.

**Good to have AI Exposure**

* Understanding of AI/ML fundamentals — supervised vs unsupervised learning, model training, evaluation metrics, and data pipelines.
* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) — prompt engineering, fine-tuning concepts, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and API-based integrations.
* Familiarity with generative AI use cases in enterprise contexts — summarization, classification, content generation, conversational bots, and intelligent search.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools for code generation, test scaffolding, or automated code review.
* Basic comfort with Python or similar languages for scripting AI/ML workflows, data wrangling, or prototyping.
* Awareness of responsible AI principles — bias, explainability, data privacy, and governance considerations.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–9 years of hands-on Salesforce platform development — cloud-agnostic, problem-first.
* Active Salesforce certifications preferred — Platform Developer I/II, Application Architect, System Architect, or any specialist certification.
* Clear communicator who can explain a complex technical tradeoff to a business stakeholder without their eyes glazing over.

title: Senior AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Engineering Expert
  
  
Role Overview
  
We are seeking experienced AI Evaluation Engineers specializing in engineering simulation and design to author and validate complex, simulation-based engineering problems for training and evaluating state-of-the-art AI agents. The role spans electrical, mechanical, control systems, aerospace, systems, and robotics engineering. You will create challenging, multi-constraint tasks that require agents to interpret requirements, navigate trade-offs, configure open-source simulation tools, diagnose failures, and iterate toward valid solutions. You will analyze agent execution logs, identify reasoning and tool-use gaps, and build objective automated graders.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
Author self-contained engineering design tasks with competing constraints, explicit optimization targets, validated reference solutions, and objective autograders.
  
Build, run, and validate problem environments using open-source simulation tools and custom Python test benches.
  
Analyze agent outputs and execution logs across repeated trials to identify systemic failure modes, such as misinterpreting simulator feedback, premature convergence, or physically impossible geometries.
  
Refine benchmark difficulty based on model performance data while avoiding ambiguity or missing information.
  
Collaborate with AI researchers, pod leads, and domain experts to integrate rigorous benchmarks into model-evaluation pipelines.
  
Requirements
  
A master's degree or PhD in electrical, mechanical, or aerospace engineering, and 10+ years of hands-on engineering design experience. The description also lists a bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in any field as an education pathway.
  
Proficiency in at least one relevant open-source simulation package, such as ngspice, PySpice, OpenFOAM, FEniCSx, CalculiX, python-control, CadQuery, build123d, OpenModelica, Cantera, or Gmsh, along with strong Python scripting skills.
  
Hands-on experience with modern LLMs or coding agents and evaluation concepts such as pass@k, failure-mode analysis, and nondeterministic behavior; ability to audit trajectory logs and isolate reasoning or tool-use failures.
  
Strong attention to physical plausibility, unit consistency, boundary conditions, convergence criteria, and technical documentation.
  
A stable, high-speed internet connection and a personal computer suitable for remote work.
  
Availability for 40 hours per week, four hours of overlap with PST, and weekend on-call availability. Part-time engagement is also noted as acceptable.

title: QA Automation Engineer (Remote, Full-Time) [HR217]
description:
**About Smart Working**

  
  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

  
  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  
  

**About the Role**

  

As a QA Automation Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of quality across a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo digital health platform. You will build the automated test framework hands-on, define expected behaviour, and help improve reliability from an existing baseline where test coverage and pass rates need strengthening.

  

You will work with an engineering team of 4, collaborating to understand how the system should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives. The role is predominantly hands-on and independent, with shared responsibility for product quality.

  

The first phase will involve speaking with stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and building out automation that enables faster, safer releases.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Own the quality process end to end and build the automated test framework hands-on.
  
* Understand how a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo system works and how it should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives.
  
* Ask the right questions and document expected behaviour where inherited documentation is partly out of date.
  
* Author English-readable scenarios in Cucumber and Gherkin.
  
* Build automation in JavaScript and TypeScript.
  
* Drive the UI through a page object model.
  
* Add data-test-ids to React code where missing.
  
* Validate correct database state using SQL.
  
* Maintain the automated tests as new features arrive.
  
* Feed into requirements upfront as new features are planned.
  
* Flag compliance, regulatory and security implications.
  
* Run exploratory testing to identify where the product behaves incorrectly.
  
* Improve reliability and enable faster, safer releases through automation.
  
* Reproduce multi-step defects precisely and identify edge cases.
  
* Build a repeatable, documented QA process from an unreliable baseline.
  
* Work out how the system should behave across multiple user perspectives and how it might break.
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* 4+ years of experience in QA or test automation, hands-on with TypeScript or JavaScript.
  
* 4+ years of hands-on test automation coding in TypeScript or JavaScript.
  
* 2+ years of BDD test authoring with Cucumber and Gherkin.
  
* 3+ years of web UI test automation using a page object model, preferably with Playwright.
  
* 2+ years of end-to-end QA ownership, including defining, documenting, building and maintaining tests.
  
* 3+ years of requirements analysis and stakeholder communication.
  
* 2+ years of SQL querying to validate database state, using MySQL or PostgreSQL.
  
* 3+ years of exploratory testing and precise multi-step defect reproduction.
  
* Ability to drive automation and own the build with limited direction.
  
* Strong detail orientation, including the ability to spot edge cases and gaps in specifications.
  
* Hands-on JavaScript or TypeScript automation coding is non-negotiable; willingness to learn is not sufficient.
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Mobile app testing and automation experience, especially with Flutter apps.
  
* Experience with Appium or Flutter integration\_test.
  
* Experience reading and working with React front-end code.
  
* Experience with Angular, Vue or another modern JavaScript framework.
  
* Security and regulatory awareness, including ISO 27001, GDPR or NHS DTAC.
  
* Experience in another regulated or audited environment.
  
* ISO 13485 medical-device regulated-environment testing.
  
* Experience in an adjacent regulated domain such as medtech, fintech or NHS/DTAC.
  
* Healthtech or digital health domain experience.
  
* Comfort using AI in the engineering workflow.
  

  
**Benefits**
  

  
* Fixed Shifts: 12:00 PM - 9:30 PM IST (Summer) | 1:00 PM - 10:30 PM IST (Winter)
  
* No Weekend Work: Real work-life balance, not just words
  
* Day 1 Benefits: Laptop and full medical insurance provided
  
* Support That Matters:Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared
  
* True Belonging: A long-term career where your contributions are valued

title: Associate, AI Model Validation, RQA
description:
**About This Role**
**Business Overview**
The Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s fiduciary and enterprise risks.  RQA’s principal objectives are to advance the firm’s risk management practices and to deliver independent risk expertise and constructive challenge to drive better business and investment outcomes.
  
  
RQA is committed to investing in our people to increase individual enablement and ultimately build a stronger team. Our goal is to create a culture of inclusion which encourages collaboration, innovation, diversity and the development our future leaders.  We actively engage in discussions on career growth and work with team members to understand how personal passions and strength connect with our purpose.
  
  
**Role Description**
The Enterprise Risk team within RQA oversees those risks which directly impact the corporate entity (i.e. BlackRock, Inc., or one of its subsidiaries), rather than the fiduciary risks assumed by funds/clients, such as investment risks and counterparty risks. The team’s focus includes but is not limited to operational risk, technology, vendor, model and market risk, stress testing for market risk and the quantitative estimation of capital adequacy requirements.
  
  
The
**AI Validation**
Associate will perform independent reviews of AI tools and agents used across BlackRock, including agentic systems, RAG applications and other business workflows. This role requires strong technical expertise combined with risk management skills to challenge system design, data integrity, and performance monitoring. The role will be based onsite in our GGN office.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct independent validation of AI usage in workflows, including testing for accuracy, efficiency of guardrails, orchestration, memory management and token usage.
* Design and implement comprehensive validation strategies and test plans tailored to each AI use case. Define clear success criteria and quality benchmarks to measure whether the AI solution meets all requirements and standards.
* Understand tool architecture, potential vulnerabilities and weaknesses.
* Assess conceptual soundness, methodology, and alignment with intended business use.
* Review data quality, preprocessing steps and engineering decisions for AI use cases.
* Execute functional and performance tests.
* Evaluate performance metrics, robustness, and limitations under various scenarios.
* Document validation findings, provide recommendations
* Stay current on emerging AI technologies, validation techniques, and regulatory developments.
* Communicate validation conclusions to relevant stakeholders, including escalating identified findings, risks or gaps to senior leadership and approval committees
* Collaborate with AI Engineering, Data Science, and Risk teams to enhance AI transparency and trustworthiness.

**Experience, Skills And Qualification**

* With 3-7 years’ works experience in the IT or financial industry.
* Degree or Advanced degree (MS, PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field.
* Strong understanding of generative AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic systems, prompt engineering, tool use, and modern AI application architectures.
* Experience with Python and common AI development libraries and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar).
* Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and challenge stakeholders constructively.
* Experience with one or more of the following:
* Validating usage of large language models (LLMs) in business context
* Evaluation methodologies, benchmark development, ground-truth creation, and AI quality assessment
* AI observability, monitoring, performance measurement, and operational controls
* AI orchestration frameworks, agent architectures, prompt engineering, memory management, and context optimization
* Exposure to cloud-based AI platforms and scalable model deployment
* MCP, APIs, connectors and integrations of AI solutions with enterprise systems and data sources
* Responsible AI practices, including fairness, explainability, bias assessment, transparency, and model governance
* Fine-tuning or model customization techniques
* Security testing and risk assessment of AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreak, and data leakage testing

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Introduction To Team**
Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travelers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.
  
  
The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.
  
  
We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.
  
  
As a Senior SDE, you will set the technical direction for core Data Quality Platform services and drive their design, delivery, and operation end to end. You will be a hands-on technical leader—writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, and data health experiences, and raising the engineering bar for the team. Your work will directly determine how effectively engineering, analytics, and data teams across Expedia Group can trust and act on their data at scale.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design, build, and maintain complex, highly available Data Quality Platform services and applications, including robust system design (low-level design), API design (REST/gRPC), and data modeling across batch and streaming domains.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of features and services—from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization in production—spanning profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, and alerting.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by driving code quality standards, reducing incidents, strengthening observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost of high-throughput data systems.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and distributed-systems architecture, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, data platform teams, and data domain owners to translate business and data-trust problems into scalable technical solutions that can be reused across domains.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled and machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying AI/ML concepts to practical data platform workflows.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 8+ years of professional backend software development experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end-to-end delivery for services or components—including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support—within a multi-service or domain environment.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and core software engineering practices, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control.
* Hands-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable and maintainable systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low-level designs.
* Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including integration with batch or streaming pipelines (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Airflow) and backward-compatible APIs.
* Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, or analytics systems, or a closely related domain.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data-informed tradeoffs on scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, SRE practices, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, including safely integrating AI/ML-enabled features into existing services.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and mentoring others to grow their technical depth and delivery capability—including guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI-assisted development and testing tools.

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
  
  
**Important notice**
Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Translate overarching business goals into scalable, resilient, and decoupled platform capabilities.

* Deep Hands-on Coding & Automation: Proficiency in at least one modern systems programming language (e.g., Golang, Python) along with advanced scripting (Bash). Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and systems software design.
* Infrastructure-as-Code Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with Terraform(custom provider/module development, state locking, drift detection) and Policy-as-Code engines (e.g., OPA, Rego, Kyverno).
* Kubernetes Internals: Comprehensive understanding of Kubernetes internals (control plane components, CNI/CSI, custom controllers/operators, RBAC, API extensions, and scheduling primitives).
* Mentorship & Influence: Proven track record of guiding junior engineers, driving engineering consensus across disparate teams, and leading technical initiatives without direct authority.
* Observability & Reliability: Hands-on experience with modern observability platforms, distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana ecosystems, and enterprise SRE practices.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep experience with Securing Cloud Native Platform.
* Experience designing, building, or operating large-scale Data Platforms is highly desirable.
* Active contributions to open-source cloud-native projects (CNCF ecosystem).

* Extensive knowledge of Hatch’s engineering management systems
* Strong ability to delegate tasks and promote the effective performance of team members
* Sound technical experience of the major equipment
* Experience in mentoring young professionals and able to steward their professional development in a project environment

title: Lead Quality Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
**The Role: Lead Quality Engineer**
**The Team**
Enterprise Solutions (ES) Technology brings together data, software, services, and expertise to deliver innovative solutions for global financial markets. The team works closely with customers to help them manage complex business, regulatory, and risk requirements.
  
  
Financial Risk Analytics (FRA), part of Enterprise Solutions, delivers information-centric capital markets and risk solutions for trading desks and their risk-management partners. Its products support counterparty credit risk, xVA, and market risk for both buy-side and sell-side institutions.
  
  
We are seeking a Lead Quality Engineer to join the FRA Technology team. Quality Engineering is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle and spans application, analytics, data, integration, and platform layers. The successful candidate will help evolve QA from a primarily validation-focused function into a proactive, automation-first, engineering-led capability.
  
  
**The Impact**
As a Lead Quality Engineer, you will own and influence the quality strategy across the software delivery lifecycle—from requirements and solution design through development, release, and production support. You will partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support teams to identify risks early, improve test coverage, increase release confidence, and promote shared accountability for quality.
  
  
This role requires strong technical expertise, a solid understanding of financial risk platforms, and the ability to lead quality initiatives across agile delivery teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously improve the quality strategy across the full software development lifecycle, embedding effective quality gates from requirements and design through release and production support.
* Shift quality engineering from defect detection to defect prevention by identifying risks, control gaps, and testability concerns early in the delivery process.
* Lead the design, development, and evolution of scalable automated test frameworks covering UI, API, data, integration, regression, and other relevant testing areas.
* Develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test suites based on software requirements, technical specifications, business workflows, and real-world customer usage.
* Drive risk-based testing for financial risk platforms, prioritising coverage for regulatory workflows, calculation accuracy, data integrity, security controls, system integration, and customer-critical journeys.
* Design and implement test automation using Java, Python, Selenium, Cucumber, Carina, and other appropriate technologies and frameworks.
* Establish and monitor quality engineering standards and metrics, including automation coverage, defect leakage, release readiness, test reliability, environment stability, and production incident feedback.
* Champion continuous testing within CI/CD pipelines by integrating reliable and efficient automated validation into build, deployment, and release processes.
* Improve release confidence and operational resilience by validating deployment readiness, rollback capability, observability, environment consistency, and applicable non-functional requirements.
* Lead quality governance for agile teams, ensuring that acceptance criteria, test evidence, sign-offs, and release risks are clearly documented, auditable, and decision-ready.
* Manage and support QA and UAT environments, build deployments, test data, test execution, release planning, and testing sign-off activities.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support to resolve quality issues and strengthen end-to-end software reliability.

* Mentor QA engineers and influence developers to build quality into their work by promoting automation, code quality, testability, maintainability, and shared ownership.
* Perform gap analysis across application and platform test coverage and define remediation plans to address identified risks.
* Balance manual and automated testing based on delivery needs, while continuously moving toward automation-first and analytics-driven quality engineering.
* Act as a technical leader and subject-matter expert, proactively resolving issues, managing risks, and escalating concerns appropriately.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may also be considered.
* 10 plus years of work experience across software quality engineering and end-to-end testing activities, including experience in a technical leadership or lead QA capacity.
* Strong hands-on experience with automation and white-box testing using Java, Python, or both.
* Experience designing and maintaining test automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, Carina, or equivalent web-testing frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience with API and web services testing, including the development or use of API automation frameworks.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software testing principles, test design techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases; knowledge of PL/SQL, NoSQL databases, and Linux/UNIX environments is desirable.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and working with build and deployment processes.
* Understanding of performance, integration, regression, data, security, and non-functional testing practices.
* Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues across application, data, and platform layers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present quality risks and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cross-functional and geographically distributed agile teams.

title: Senior AI Test Engineer
description:
Senior AI Test Engineer

**Location:**
Remote

About the Role

Alternative Path is looking for a
**Senior AI Test Engineer**
to lead quality assurance on a client engagement with a leading financial data and analytics company that has built AI agent systems (chatbots, RAG-based research/report generation, MCP-based tool-calling agents) on top of its proprietary datasets for its own clients. This is a senior, client-facing role: you'll own the test strategy for these systems end-to-end, working directly with the client's engineering team to validate accuracy, reliability, and safety before these agents reach financial industry end-users — where hallucinations or bad data retrieval carry real business risk.

This is not conventional QA. You'll be building evaluation frameworks and datasets, running systematic evals, and defining quality bars for non-deterministic, LLM-driven systems operating over complex financial data.

**About Alternative Path**

Alternative Path is a strategic operations consulting firm, founded in 2020, that helps growth-stage and enterprise organizations build high-performing, India-based teams across Technology Ops, Data Ops, Business Intelligence, and Finance. Every engagement is senior-led, and the firm has delivered 50+ engagements for clients across the US, Europe, and Australia.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the
  **test and evaluation strategy**
  for the client's AI agent systems — chatbots, RAG-based research/report generation, and MCP-based tool-calling agents
* Design and build
  **eval suites**
  covering accuracy, groundedness/faithfulness to source data, task completion, latency, and safety
* Build and curate
  **golden datasets**
  reflecting real client use cases and financial-data edge cases (ambiguous queries, stale data, conflicting sources, numerical precision)
* Use eval/observability tooling such as
  **LangSmith**
  (or equivalents — Ragas, DeepEval, Braintrust, Langfuse, PromptFoo) to trace, score, and monitor agent runs
* Define and track RAG-specific metrics (retrieval precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation/source accuracy) — critical given the systems sit on top of financial datasets where correctness is non-negotiable
* Evaluate MCP-based tool-calling behavior — correct tool selection, multi-step task execution, failure handling
* Design regression testing so prompt, model, or data-pipeline changes don't silently degrade quality
* Run structured red-teaming for hallucinations, prompt injection, and unsafe/incorrect financial outputs
* Act as the primary quality point of contact with the client's engineering stakeholders — translating findings into clear, actionable risk assessments
* Mentor/guide any junior QA resources staffed onto the engagement as it scales
* Build automation to integrate evals into CI pipelines where feasible

What We're Looking For

**Must-haves**

* **3+ years**
  in software QA/testing, with
  **hands-on senior-level experience evaluating LLM-based or agentic AI systems**
  (not just traditional QA)
* Direct experience with
  **eval frameworks/tools**
  — LangSmith strongly preferred; also acceptable: Ragas, DeepEval, PromptFoo, Braintrust, Langfuse
* Strong understanding of
  **RAG architecture**
  and how to independently evaluate retrieval quality vs. generation quality
* Practical familiarity with
  **MCP (Model Context Protocol)**
  or comparable agent tool-calling frameworks
* Strong Python skills for building test harnesses, scoring pipelines, and automation
* Experience designing evaluation approaches for
  **non-deterministic**
  systems (probabilistic scoring, not binary pass/fail)
* Comfortable working
  **directly with client engineering teams**
  — strong communication, able to explain quality risk to both technical and business stakeholders
* Prior experience in a
  **client services / consulting QA environment**
  (this is a client-facing engagement, not an internal product team)

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience testing AI systems in
  **fintech, capital markets, or data/analytics**
  domains
* Familiarity with financial data accuracy/compliance considerations (numerical precision, source traceability, audit trails)
* Exposure to LLM red-teaming/safety evaluation practices
* Experience with browser-automation agent testing (Playwright or similar)

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s most trusted Muslim Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. With
**65,000+ success storie**
s and
**over 2 Million+ members**
, we are committed to fostering strong connections and building a better community. Our AI-based algorithm ensures seamless profile searches and connections, transforming the way people approach marriage. Based in India, NikahForever has created a user-friendly platform where finding your life partner happens in just three steps: Register, Search, and Connect.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an engineer who can
**think independently, solve difficult problems, and turn ideas into reliable production software.**

You won't always get a detailed specification or a step-by-step implementation plan. You'll get a problem, its context, and the freedom to figure out how to solve it. You'll learn unfamiliar systems, make practical engineering decisions, build and test solutions, and take ownership of your work from implementation through deployment.

We're AI-native. You'll use AI coding agents and modern engineering tools to accelerate development, explore unfamiliar codebases, debug issues, and automate repetitive work. You'll remain accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of everything you ship.

We don't hire based on familiarity with a particular programming language, framework, or technology stack.
**We value strong fundamentals, problem-solving ability, learning speed, engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver working software.**

**What You'll Do**

* **Build and ship software:**
  Turn product requirements and business problems into working, reliable software that delivers measurable value.
* **Own features end to end:**
  Understand requirements, explore possible solutions, implement features, write tests, deploy changes, and fix issues after release.
* **Solve engineering problems:**
  Break down ambiguous problems, evaluate trade-offs, reason through edge cases, and develop practical solutions without relying on step-by-step instructions.
* **Work across domains:**
  Contribute to backend systems, APIs, databases, infrastructure, integrations, data-intensive applications, and AI-powered workflows as the problem requires.
* **Navigate unfamiliar systems:**
  Understand existing codebases, investigate how components interact, and adapt to new technologies without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker.
* **Debug and investigate:**
  Reproduce failures, analyze logs and system behavior, identify root causes, and implement fixes that prevent recurring problems.
* **Make sound technical decisions:**
  Consider correctness, performance, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, and implementation complexity when choosing a solution.
* **Use AI-native engineering workflows:**
  Leverage AI coding agents for exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring. Review their output critically and verify that solutions work as intended.
* **Automate repetitive work:**
  Identify inefficient manual processes and build tools or automations that improve productivity and reduce operational effort.
* **Collaborate and take ownership:**
  Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and technical problem-solving. Communicate blockers early and incorporate feedback constructively.
* **Continuously improve:**
  Learn from production issues, measure the impact of your work, and improve the quality and reliability of the systems you build.

**Examples of Problems You'll Tackle**

* Build a new product capability from an ambiguous requirement, making appropriate implementation and design decisions along the way.
* Investigate a slow or unreliable service, identify its bottlenecks, and improve its performance and resilience.
* Design a reliable workflow for processing tasks asynchronously, handling failures, and preventing data inconsistencies.
* Build an AI-powered workflow that uses external tools and APIs to automate a multi-step business process.
* Investigate a production failure in an unfamiliar codebase, identify the root cause, and ship a thoroughly tested fix.
* Develop an internal tool that removes repetitive manual work and measure the resulting improvement in efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must Have**

* Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to reason systematically about unfamiliar problems.
* A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and essential software design principles.
* The ability to write clear, maintainable, and testable code, regardless of the programming language or technology used.
* A practical understanding of how software components interact, including APIs, databases, networking, and operating systems.
* The ability to break down complex tasks into smaller, verifiable steps and make progress without constant supervision.
* Comfort navigating unfamiliar codebases, learning new technologies, and adapting to different technical environments.
* A disciplined approach to debugging, testing, handling edge cases, and investigating the root causes of failures.
* The judgment to make reasonable technical trade-offs and recognize when a solution is unnecessarily complex or unreliable.
* Practical familiarity with AI coding tools or a demonstrated willingness to adopt them, along with the ability to validate generated code critically.
* Strong ownership, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias toward finishing and shipping work.
* The ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, ask useful questions, and take feedback constructively.
* Evidence of practical engineering ability through projects, internships, research, open-source contributions, or other work demonstrating problem-solving and implementation skills.

**Strong Plus**

* **B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program.**
* Experience building and deploying software that solves a real problem for actual users.
* Experience diagnosing performance issues, improving reliability, or resolving difficult technical bugs.
* Exposure to production systems, cloud environments, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, or incident investigation.
* Experience working across multiple technical domains or adapting to unfamiliar technology stacks.
* Projects involving AI-powered applications, LLMs, autonomous agents, or workflow automation.
* Practical experience using AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining strong quality standards.
* Contributions to products, tools, research, or open-source projects that demonstrate initiative beyond completing tutorials.
* Evidence of independently taking an idea from initial problem discovery to a working, tested solution.

**How You'll Be Evaluated**

* **Engineering and project review:**
  Walk us through something you've built, the problem it solves, your personal contribution, and the decisions you made.
* **Practical problem-solving:**
  Work through an engineering problem that assesses reasoning, implementation, edge cases, and correctness rather than familiarity with a particular technology.
* **Code implementation and debugging:**
  Build or modify a solution in a practical environment, investigate failures, and demonstrate how you test your work.
* **System design and reasoning:**
  Approach an open-ended problem, explain the major components, evaluate trade-offs, and reason about reliability and future growth.
* **AI-assisted engineering exercise:**
  Use an AI agent to explore, build, or debug a solution while demonstrating how you guide, inspect, and verify its work.
* **Ownership and learning discussion:**
  Discuss a difficult problem you've solved, a mistake you've made, how you handled feedback, and how you approach unfamiliar technology.

**Why Join**

* Own meaningful engineering problems and contribute directly to product outcomes.
* Work across different technical domains rather than being restricted to a single technology stack.
* Learn how production systems are designed, built, deployed, monitored, and scaled.
* Use AI coding agents and modern engineering workflows to solve real-world problems.
* Develop strong engineering judgment through practical challenges, code reviews, and production ownership.
* Work in an environment that values initiative, learning speed, technical depth, and measurable impact.

**We value engineering ability over technology-stack familiarity, demonstrated problem-solving over memorized answers, and the ability to learn and deliver over experience with a specific tool.**

**Apply Now!**

In the early phase, you will be working mobile, meeting clients across Nice and the French Riviera. Once volumes build, we will establish a permanent office space in the region, and you will have the opportunity to grow with us into that.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and versatile Senior QA Automation Engineer to lead our testing efforts across our entire application suite. In this role, you will be responsible for full-cycle testing from exploratory manual testing to architecting and building out our automated testing frameworks from scratch. You will also leverage the latest AI-driven QA tools to accelerate test creation and improve coverage. If you have a deep understanding of modern QA methodologies, love breaking software to make it better, and want to own the quality standards for a growing engineering team, this is the perfect opportunity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Test Strategy & Execution:**
  Perform comprehensive all-around testing, including functional, integration, regression, performance, and cross-browser testing for both frontend and backend systems.
* **Automation Architecture:**
  Design, build, and maintain scalable automated testing frameworks from the ground up for web applications and APIs.
* **AI-Assisted Testing:**
  Leverage AI-powered testing tools and coding assistants to accelerate test script generation, create intelligent test data, and reduce test maintenance overhead.
* **CI/CD Integration:**
  Integrate automated test suites into continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure code quality upon every deployment.
* **API & Backend Testing:**
  Thoroughly test RESTful and GraphQL APIs to ensure data integrity, security, and performance.
* **Manual & Exploratory Testing:**
  Identify edge cases and complex user flows that require manual validation before translating them into automated scripts where applicable.
* **Defect Management:**
  Track, document, and triage bugs clearly, working closely with full-stack developers and product managers to resolve issues quickly.
* **Quality Advocacy:**
  Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for QA, mentor team members, and foster a culture of quality across the organization.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Experience:**
  5+ years of QA experience, with at least 2-3 years focused heavily on building test automation frameworks from scratch.
* **Core Languages:**
  Strong programming skills in JavaScript or TypeScript for writing maintainable test scripts.
* **Automation Tools:**
  Hands-on expertise with modern UI automation tools like Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
* **AI Testing Experience:**
  Familiarity with AI-driven testing platforms (e.g., Mabl, Testim, Percy) or using AI coding assistants (like GitHub Copilot) to optimize testing workflows.
* **API Testing:**
  Proven experience testing APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or equivalent automated libraries.

  Basic understanding of performance testing (e.g., JMeter, k6) and standard web security vulnerabilities.
* **DevOps Basics:**
