title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**

* Hands-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.

**Education**

* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.

**Tii Elements**

* **Curiosity:**
  Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:**
  Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:**
  Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal & external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self-Awareness & Impact:**
  Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.
  
  
**Our Mission**
is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
  
  
  
  
**Our Values**
underpin everything we do.
  

* **Customer Centric:**
  Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:**
  We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:**
  Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action & Ownership:**
  We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:**
  We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:**
  We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

**Global Benefits**

* Remote First Culture

* Self-Care Days

* Retirement Plan with match/contribution\*

\* varies by country
  
  
**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**
  
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

- Security, privacy, and compliance
- Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost

+ Own production systems post go\-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution.

* 
+ Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production\-grade GenAI systems, including:
- Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
- Agentic workflows and tool\-based orchestration

+ Drive consistent adoption of:
- Clean and modular architecture patterns
- Reusable components and shared frameworks
- CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud\-native practices

* AI Platform Engineering \& MLOps / LLMOps
+ Build and evolve AI platforms that support:
- Model lifecycle management
- LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
- Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
- Secure access, auditability, and governance

+ Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non\-functional requirements over time, not just at launch.

+ Coach engineers on:
- Backend and distributed systems engineering
- GenAI application design and implementation
- Writing maintainable, testable, production\-quality code

+ Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement.
+ Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs.

- AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams

+ Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs.

title: AI Architect
description:
**About Us**
 Sauce Labs is the world’s largest full\-lifecycle, test automation platform, and the company behind Selenium. Trusted by 80% of the world’s top ten largest financial institutions and over 300,000 enterprise users, Sauce Labs provides the only AI platform capable of turning business intent into autonomous testing and quality assurance. With a proprietary dataset of 8\.7 billion test runs, Sauce Labs empowers the Fortune 2000 to bridge the gap between AI\-driven code generation and enterprise\-grade software quality. Learn more at saucelabs.com.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are seeking an innovative and experienced AI Architect to join our engineering leadership team. This is a strategic role that will be instrumental in designing and building the next generation of AI\-powered features for our continuous testing platform. You will be responsible for architecting scalable and robust AI solutions that transform how our customers gain insights from their test data and production environments, and how they create tests.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define AI Architecture: Lead the design and architecture of cutting\-edge AI/ML solutions for new product offerings, ensuring scalability, performance, quality and reliability within a cloud\-native environment.
* AI\-Powered Insights (Test \& Production): Architect AI systems to derive actionable insights from vast quantities of test run logs and analytics data. This includes identifying patterns, anomalies, and performance trends.
* Production Error Reporting Integration: Design AI solutions that integrate with our existing error reporting product to analyze production issues for mobile and web applications, providing deeper understanding and predictive capabilities.
* Unified Data Intelligence: Develop architectures for combining insights from both test runs and production data, creating a holistic view of application quality and user experience.
* Automated Failure Analysis \& Remediation: Architect AI models and systems that can automatically identify failures in test runs, diagnose root causes, and suggest potential fixes or optimizations.
* AI\-Assisted Test Case Generation: Design AI\-driven capabilities to assist in the intelligent generation of test cases, improving test coverage and efficiency.
* Leverage Cloud AI Platforms: Work extensively with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, specifically focusing on leveraging and integrating with our self\-hosted versions of Gemini Flash models for text generation and understanding.
* Data Strategy \& Pipeline: Collaborate with data engineering teams to define and optimize data pipelines, ensuring efficient data flow from sources (Snowflake, with an eye towards Google BigQuery) to AI models.


**Enhance Delivery Process: Help identify the areas of opportunity for delivery process improvements through AI tools and validate the feasibility.**
* Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams, guiding them in the implementation and deployment of AI/ML solutions. Take part in AI governance projects.
* Research \& Innovation: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in AI/ML, evaluating new technologies and methodologies to continuously enhance our product offerings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product management, engineering teams, and senior leadership to translate business requirements into technical AI solutions and roadmaps.


**Required Skills**
**Education \& Experience:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in software development and architecture of production\-grade systems.
* Extensive AI/ML Architecture Experience: Proven experience in designing, building, and deploying large\-scale AI/ML systems and platforms in a production environment.
* Cloud Expertise (GCP Preferred): Deep hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services relevant to AI/ML (e.g., Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow).
* Generative AI Experience: Practical experience with large language models (LLMs), particularly with models like Gemini Flash, and understanding of their deployment and fine\-tuning (especially with regard to prompt engineering, agent orchestration, context windows management and output validation)
* Big Data \& Analytics: Strong background in working with large datasets, data warehousing (Snowflake, BigQuery), and analytics platforms.
* Software Engineering Foundation: Solid understanding of software development best practices, scalable system design, and microservices architectures.
* Problem\-Solving \& Innovation: Exceptional analytical skills with a track record of solving complex, ambiguous problems using AI/ML techniques.
* Leadership \& Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
* Hands\-on Capability: While an architectural role, a willingness to be hands\-on with prototyping, proof\-of\-concepts, and guiding implementation.
* Domain Knowledge (Highly Desired): Familiarity with software testing, quality assurance, DevOps, or application performance monitoring.


**Nice To Haves**
* Experience with MLOps practices and tools for managing the ML lifecycle.
* Contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects or relevant publications.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.


 We are a hybrid workplace that recognizes the importance of flexibility while valuing in\-person collaboration and relationship building. As a result, Saucers located near an office location must be able and willing to come into the office.
   

  

 Please note our Privacy Policy for Applicants when applying for a job at Sauce Labs.
   

  

 Sauce Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity/expression/status, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status.
   

  

 Security responsibilities at Sauce
   

  

 At Sauce, we will commit to supporting the health and safety of employees and properties, partnering with internal stakeholders to learn and act on ever\-evolving security protocols and procedures. You’ll be expected to fully comply with all policies and procedures related to security at the department and org wide level and exercise a ‘security first’ approach to how we design, build \& run our products and services.

**Role Overview:**
 Are you passionate about building software solutions and platforms from the ground up? Would you like to help drive the digital transformations in the private equity industry at Colmore?
   

  

 We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team and build one of the most important new products from the ground up, which is at the center of Colmore’s technology initiatives.

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Support the complete Software Development Life Cycle (requirements gathering, development, testing, deployment, support).
* Develop software that is modular, reusable, and extensible.
* Write code that is easy to understand and maintain.
* Design and implement low\-latency, high\-availability, and performant applications.
* Perform unit tests and develop automated tests.
* Build RESTful APIs.
* Conduct timely code reviews.


**Key Requirement For This Role**
 We expect you to have a solid foundation in data structures, programming languages, common design patterns, and software engineering best practices.
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science, or related degree.
* Development experience in .Net, .Net Core, ASP.Net Core and C\#
* Knowledge and experience using important .NET and C\# language features such as encapsulation, inheritance, interfaces, polymorphism, generics, exception handling, reflection, attributes, LINQ, and asynchronous programming, etc.
* Experience in using Entity Framework for data persistence
* Experience developing software with structured logging, preferably using a mature logging framework
* Knowledge and experience in SQL query language, SQL database schema design and developing software that access SQL databases
* Knowledge and experience in the HTTP protocol, REST API, authentication and authorization standards and methods
* Experience using API testing utilities such as Postman or cURL
* Knowledge and experience in Azure or AWS is a plus
* Experience using design patterns to achieve good architecture in development work
* Experience in troubleshooting and debugging issues and unblock development work by thinking out of the box and resolving problems independently
* Experience creating unit test programs to validate software component functionalities
* Experience using modern source code management systems such as Git in software development and collaboration with other developers
* Experience working with continuous integration and development (CI/CD) systems
* Ability to automate solutions to repetitive problems and tasks
* Demonstrative written and verbal communication skills working with audiences with a wide variety of technical expertise
* Passion for learning and using new technologies


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
**About SaveIN** 
 : SaveIN is a Y\-Combinator\-backed fintech company on a mission to make financial products accessible and affordable for every Indian. We offer Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and no\-cost EMI solutions through a growing network of Banks, NBFCs, and lending partners, enabling consumers to fund healthcare, education, and everyday needs without financial stress.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 : SaveIN is looking for a Senior QA Engineer with a strong automation focus to help us scale test coverage across our lending and payments platform. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and compliance teams to ensure the reliability, security, and correctness of systems that handle real money movement and sensitive customer data.
 



  





**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-Time
 



**Working Days:** 
 5 days a week
 



**Mode of Work:** 
 On\-Site
 



**Experience Required:** 
 3\-5 years
 



**Reporting To** 
 : CTO
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites (API, UI, and regression) integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Own the test strategy for critical customer journeys, including onboarding, credit decisioning, disbursement, and repayment/collections.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks for testing integrations with bank partners (HDFC, ICICI, IDFC First) and bureau/KYC providers.
* Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively build automated regression suites to reduce manual QA dependency.
* Collaborate with developers to "shift testing left" by embedding test gates into CI/CD alongside SAST/security checks.
* Perform API contract testing, load/performance testing, and data validation for financial transactions.
* Write clear, reproducible bug reports and work with engineering to drive root\-cause fixes.
* Contribute to the test data management strategy, especially around PII/DPDP\-compliant sandbox data.
* Mentor junior QA engineers and help formalize QA processes, test documentation, and release sign\-off criteria.
* Participate in production incident reviews to identify testing gaps that could have caught issues earlier.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in QA/SDET roles with a strong hands\-on automation focus.
* Proficiency with automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured, Karate).
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and integrating automated tests.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and backend testing.
* Experience testing REST APIs, webhooks, and third\-party integrations.
* Basic scripting ability (Java/Python/JavaScript) for writing and maintaining test scripts.
* Understanding of the software testing lifecycle, including test planning, traceability, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Prior experience in fintech, banking, or lending products is a strong plus (understanding of KYC, credit underwriting, or payment flows).
* Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6\) is a plus.
* Exposure to security testing basics (e.g., OWASP Top 10\) is a plus, given the regulated environment.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience testing systems with multiple bank/NBFC integrations.
* Familiarity with compliance\-driven QA (e.g., audit trails, RBI/data protection considerations).
* Interest in AI\-assisted testing tools/agentic QA workflows, as this is a growing focus area for our team.

description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building more than just AI tools; we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post\-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world. From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
   

  

 We’re a fast\-growing, passionate team backed over 100K\+ active users globally.
   

  

 But we’re just getting started. Our mission is clear: solve the biggest pain points in photography, and keep evolving with photographers who use our tools daily.
   

  

 If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
   

  

 🚀
 **About the Role**
 A wedding photographer shoots 4,000 photos on a Saturday.
   

  

 Before Aftershoot, that meant three nights hunched over a screen, clicking through near\-identical frames, missing dinner, missing their kids, missing the life they take pictures of for everyone else.
   

  

 With Aftershoot, it takes an hour.
   

  

 That hour is the entire product. 100,000\+ photographers around the world trust us with it. Culling, editing, retouching \- our AI does the grunt work so they can go back to doing the thing they actually love.
   

  

 Which means when we ship a bug, we don't ship an inconvenience. We ship somebody's ruined Sunday. That's where you come in.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Every engineer here builds a piece of the product. The PM holds the plan for it. Design holds the intent.
   

  

 You're the only person on the team whose entire job is to know what the product
 **actually does** 
 .
   

  

 Not what the ticket said. Not what the spec promised. What happens when a photographer drags in 12,000 RAW files, loses Wi\-Fi halfway through, closes the laptop lid, and reopens it four hours later on battery.
   

  

 We're not hiring you to tick boxes on a test sheet. You'll write code, own an automation suite, and hold the call on whether something is fit to go in front of 100,000 photographers. We're hiring you to become the person we can't ship without.
   

  

**Here's the bar we're setting, out loud:**
 Six months in, when an engineer and a PM disagree about how a flow is supposed to behave, someone in that room should say "just ask \[your name]" and that settles it.
   

  

 You will know this product better than the people who built it. That's not a stretch goal. That's the job.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Basic programming in JavaScript or TypeScript
* Comfort with browser developer tools
* A grasp of testing fundamentals — test cases, severity, the defect lifecycle, what regression actually means
* Sharp analytical instincts and genuinely strong attention to detail
* Clear written and verbal communication (a bug report is writing)
* Real eagerness to learn automation, not just tolerance for it
* BE/B.Tech, BCA, MCA, or B.Sc in CS/IT — freshers and final\-year students very welcome


**Preferred Skills (Good To Have)**
* Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress
* Git / GitHub
* REST APIs and API testing
* Anything you've built and shipped yourself, however small

* Team Members: Vikas, Aditi and the rest of the Aftershoot team.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
We are a startup building a B2B finance platform that helps businesses access financing and manage financial workflows. Join our core engineering team and work closely with technology and product leadership to build and operate the platform.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will build automated tests and tools that verify the correctness of financial workflows. You will work with engineers from design onwards and own the regression suite and evidence used to assess releases.
 



  





**What you will do** 




**Test Automation** 




 • Build and maintain
 **API, integration, database and browser automation** 
 for business and transaction workflows. 
 



 • Develop reusable automation frameworks, utilities and test components. 
 



 • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and establish reliable regression execution. 
 



 • Maintain test suites for critical business workflows and prevent regression across releases. 
 



**Financial \& Transaction Testing** 




 • Validate
 **ledger balances, financial calculations, transaction states and state transitions** 
 . 
 



 • Test authentication, authorisation and role\-based access controls. 
 



 • Validate transaction lifecycle, including successful, rejected, cancelled and failed scenarios. 
 



 • Test
 **idempotency, retries, duplicate requests and concurrent transactions** 
 . 
 



 • Validate that financial transactions maintain data consistency across services and database operations. 
 



 • Verify audit trails and transaction history for critical business actions. 
 



**Failure \& Integration Testing** 




 • Create repeatable test data and controlled test environments. 
 



 • Simulate delayed, duplicate, rejected, partially successful and failed partner/API responses. 
 



 • Test timeout, retry and recovery behaviour for external integrations. 
 



 • Validate asynchronous workflows and eventual\-consistency scenarios. 
 



 • Test reconciliation and exception scenarios where applicable. 
 



**Quality Engineering** 




 • Work with developers and Product/Business teams to convert business rules into comprehensive test scenarios. 
 



 • Participate in design and requirement reviews and identify testability and quality risks early. 
 



 • Investigate automation failures and distinguish application defects from test/environment issues. 
 



 • Track defects, perform appropriate root\-cause analysis and verify fixes. 
 



 • Maintain release test reports, automation results and quality evidence. 
 



 • Contribute to continuous improvement of test coverage, execution time and reliability.
 



  





**What you bring** 




 •
 **5–8 years of experience** 
 in SDET, Test Automation or Software Quality Engineering.
 



 • Good programming and scripting skills in Java, Python, or another suitable language, with the ability to build and maintain automated test frameworks.
 



 • Practical experience with SQL and relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL.
 



 • Experience designing and maintaining API and integration automation frameworks.
 



 • Strong understanding of automated testing principles, test design and maintainable automation.
 



 • Experience testing:
 



 • REST APIs
 



 • Database transactions
 



 • Asynchronous workflows
 



 • Multi\-step business workflows
 



 • Failure and recovery scenarios
 



 • Experience with browser automation and end\-to\-end testing like Selenium.
 



 • Experience integrating automated tests with CI/CD pipelines.
 



 • Ability to debug issues across frontend, backend, API and database layers.
 



 • Ability to understand business rules and translate them into meaningful test scenarios.
 



 • Basic security testing must to have.
 



 • Strong defect reporting and communication skills.
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 • Experience testing FinTech, Banking, Payments, Lending, Accounting or other financial systems. 
 



 • Experience with Playwright, Selenium, REST Assured or equivalent tools. 
 



 • Experience with performance/load testing. 
 



 • Experience testing distributed systems or event\-driven architectures. 
 



 • Experience with Docker/Kubernetes\-based test environments. 
 



 • Experience validating financial reconciliation and exception management. 
 



 • Familiarity with AWS/cloud environments. 
 



 • Experience with security testing inline to OWASP, VAPT and API penetration.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for a
 **hands\-on SDET** 
 , not a manual QA engineer who primarily writes UI scripts.
 



 You should be comfortable testing a financial transaction from
 **API → service → database → ledger → external integration → reconciliation** 
 , and be able to determine whether the system has produced the correct business and financial outcome.
 



  





**Equal opportunity** 




 We are an equal opportunity employer. We assess applicants on skills, experience and role requirements, without discrimination based on age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, caste, religion, race or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
 



  





**How to apply** 



* To apply, submit your CV and a one\-page cover letter explaining your relevant experience, one system or project you personally built, and why you are interested in this role.

title: Nutanix Automation Engineer
description:
**Details:**
 The Nutanix Automation Engineer exists to create leverage. Migration at scale and ongoing platform operations both generate large volumes of repetitive, error\-prone manual work \- pre\-migration checks, bulk VM configuration, post\-cutover validation, health reporting, provisioning, and configuration drift correction. This role converts that work into scripted, API\-driven, version\-controlled automation so the migration team moves faster with fewer defects and the support team absorbs more estate without adding heads. The role is measured in hours removed and errors prevented, not in scripts written.
   

  

**Migration Automation**
* Automate pre\-migration discovery and readiness checks \- bulk inventory extraction, snapshot and VMware Tools state validation, disk and configuration compatibility screening, and blocker reporting per wave.
* Script bulk operations against Nutanix Move and the Nutanix APIs \- migration plan creation, batch VM addition, replication status polling, and progress and exception reporting to the Project Manager.
* Build post\-migration validation automation: guest reachability, service and port checks, VirtIO and driver state, disk presence, backup re\-registration, and monitoring agent check\-in \- producing a pass/fail evidence artifact per VM that supports application owner sign\-off.
* Automate post\-cutover configuration \- categories and tags, protection policy assignment, affinity rules, and resource right\-sizing recommendations based on measured utilization.


**Operational and Platform Automation**
* Develop scheduled health and compliance automation \- NCC result collection and parsing, cluster resiliency and capacity reporting, snapshot and replication compliance checks, and upgrade\-readiness assessment.
* Build self\-service and workflow automation for routine requests: VM provisioning from standard templates, resource changes, decommissioning, and access requests, with approval gates preserved.
* Implement event\-driven automation using Prism Central Playbooks (X\-Play) or equivalent \- automated triage, enrichment, and remediation for well\-understood recurring alerts.
* Integrate the Nutanix platform with the client's ITSM and CMDB \- automated ticket creation with contextual detail, asset and configuration item synchronization, and closure/status write\-back.
* Build operational reporting and dashboards \- capacity runway, migration progress, incident and change volume, and platform health trending \- for both client leadership and Stefanini governance.


**Engineering Practice and Code Quality**
* Manage all automation as code in the client's or Stefanini's version control system, with branching, peer review, and change history \- no untracked scripts on jump boxes.
* Apply infrastructure\-as\-code practice where appropriate \- Terraform Nutanix provider or Ansible collections for repeatable, declarative configuration of clusters, categories, networks, and VMs.
* Implement safe automation design: idempotency, dry\-run and reporting\-only modes, explicit confirmation for destructive operations, structured logging, and error handling that fails loudly rather than silently.
* Handle credentials and secrets correctly \- no embedded passwords or API keys; integrate with the client's approved secrets management and service account model, with least\-privilege scoping.
* Document every automation asset: purpose, prerequisites, parameters, expected output, failure modes, and rollback, so ownership can transfer without the original author.
* Contribute reusable, client\-agnostic automation assets back to the Stefanini Nutanix practice library, accelerating the next engagement.


 Job Requirements
   

  

**Details:**
**Required Technical Skills**
 
   

  

**Domain**
**Expected Depth**
 Scripting and development
   

  

 PowerShell and Python at a production level \- modules/functions, error handling, parameterization, structured output (JSON/CSV), and REST consumption
   

  

 Nutanix APIs and tooling
   

  

 Nutanix REST APIs (v3 and v4\), Prism Central Playbooks (X\-Play), Nutanix Self\-Service (Calm) blueprints where deployed, Move API/CLI
   

  

 Nutanix platform
   

  

 AOS, AHV, Prism Element and Prism Central concepts sufficient to automate safely \- categories, storage containers, protection policies, VM lifecycle
   

  

 Infrastructure as code
   

  

 Terraform (Nutanix provider) and/or Ansible (nutanix.ncp collection); familiarity with state management and drift detection
   

  

 Version control and CI/CD
   

  

 Git with peer review workflow; pipeline execution via Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins
   

  

 Integration
   

  

 ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM APIs, CMDB synchronization, monitoring/alerting integration, webhook and event\-driven patterns
   

  

 Security practice
   

  

 Least\-privilege service accounts, approved secrets management, audit logging, and change\-controlled automation execution
   

  

****Qualifications And Certifications****
* 4\+ years in infrastructure automation, DevOps, or platform engineering, including 2\+ years automating Nutanix or a comparable enterprise virtualization platform.
* Portfolio evidence required \- candidates should be able to walk through automation they authored, explain the design decisions, and describe how failure cases were handled.
* Preferred certifications: Nutanix Certified Professional \- Multicloud Infrastructure (NCP\-MCI), HashiCorp Certified Terraform Associate, Red Hat Certified Engineer or Ansible Automation certification, Microsoft PowerShell\-relevant certification.
* Experience automating within a regulated environment where change control, auditability, and separation of duties constrain how automation is authorized and executed.

* Exposure to retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), agent‑based systems, and prompt engineering best practices.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Strong working knowledge of Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Understanding of model risk management, explainability, and governance in regulated environments.
* Prior experience delivering AI solutions in Investment Banking or Capital Markets.


 This role will be based out of Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop, implement, and support mathematical, statistical, and machine learning models and analytics used in business decision\-making
   

  

**Accountabilities**

**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..

They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Lead SDET
description:
**Role:** 

 Lead SDET (Quality \& Release)
 




**Location:** 

 Gurgaon, India (On\-site)
 




**Employment Type:** 

 Full\-time
 




**Experience Required:** 

 5 – 7 years
 




  





  





**ABOUT** 





 Visitly is a visitor management platform used across 25\+ countries by enterprises with serious security requirements — Fortune 500 companies spanning technology, cybersecurity, hardware and transportation. When someone walks into one of their lobbies, our software is what stands between the front door and the building.
 




  





**WHY THIS ROLE IS INTERESTING** 





 Our failure modes are real ones. A badge that doesn’t print stalls in a lobby. A broken SSO integration locks out a customer’s entire security team. Tenant isolation has to hold absolutely, every time.
 





 And the surface we have to cover is genuinely hard: a Java/Spring Boot backend, an Angular web app, a React Native mobile app, an iPad kiosk, physical badge printers and badge readers, 50\+ third\-party integrations, and multi\-tenant architecture underneath all of it.
 





 Testing everything isn’t an option. Deciding what matters most, and being right about it, is the job.
 




  





**WHAT YOU’LL OWN** 



* Quality strategy — build the risk model for our product: which flows must never break, what depth of coverage each one deserves, and where automation earns its maintenance cost
* The automation layer — shape our test architecture at the right levels, integrated into CI, fast enough that engineers rely on it rather than route around it
* Release management — own the release gate, go/no\-go, staged rollout, and rollback. You’ll have real authority here and the backing to use it
* The team — lead and grow a small QA team, hands\-on alongside them
* Production feedback — close the loop between what happens in the field and what we test, including the observability that makes debugging fast


- 


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** 



* 5–7 years in software quality, with meaningful time at a product company — somewhere you shipped your own software to your own customers and lived with the consequences
* You write code. Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript — the language matters less than the fact that you build tools rather than only use them
* You’ve built or substantially rebuilt an automation framework and put it into CI, and can explain the trade\-offs you made
* You’ve owned or co\-owned a release process, and you’ve been in a production incident
* You have opinions about testing that you can argue for — and that you’ve changed at least once





 ﻿
 





**Bonus:** 

 hardware or device matrices, multi\-tenant SaaS, SSO/SAML/SCIM, mobile or kiosk testing.
 




  





**WHO THIS ISN’T FOR** 





 We’ll be direct, because it saves us both time.
 





 This isn’t a role where you bring the process that worked at your last company and install it here. Our constraints are different — smaller team, faster cycles, stranger test surface, higher stakes per defect. A playbook built for a twenty\-person QA org and a two\-week regression cycle won’t survive contact with how we work.
 





 It’s also not a role for a pure QA management profile. If your experience is running testing as a separate function or a services engagement — headcount, test case volume, defect throughput — this will be a poor fit in both directions.
 




  






 We care much less about test case counts, certifications, or deep expertise in one specific tool. We care much more about how you decide what’s worth testing when you can’t test everything, what you do when there’s no spec and the person who built the feature has moved on, and whether you can change your mind when the evidence changes.
 




  





  





**WHAT WE OFFER** 



* Full ownership of a function, built from the ground up, with a direct line to leadership
* Meaningful equity in a profitable, growing company
* A hard technical problem, with enterprise customers who hold us to a high bar
* No layers between you and the decisions

title: Senior QE Engineer
description:
For over four decades, PAR Technology Corporation (NYSE: PAR) has been a leader in restaurant technology, empowering brands worldwide to create lasting connections with their guests. Our innovative solutions and commitment to excellence provide comprehensive software and hardware that enable seamless experiences and drive growth for over 100,000 restaurants in more than 110 countries. Embracing our "Better Together" ethos, we offer Unified Customer Experience solutions, combining point\-of\-sale, digital ordering, loyalty and back\-office software solutions as well as industry\-leading hardware and drive\-thru offerings. To learn more, visit partech.com or connect with us on LinkedIn, X (formerly Twitter), Facebook, and Instagram.
   

  

 We're looking for a Senior QE Engineer with deep expertise in automation and performance testing, AI\-augmented testing, to help us deliver high\-quality software at scale. In this role, you'll serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on quality practices, design robust test strategies, and contribute to building scalable and reliable systems. You'll work closely with cross\-functional teams to drive automation, performance testing, and quality initiatives across the platform.
   

  

**Position Location:** 
 Jaipur/Gurugram
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Manager QE
   

  

**What We are Looking For: Key Skills \& Responsibilities**
* 5–8 years of experience in Quality Engineering with strong expertise in enterprise SaaS applications.
* Strong hands\-on experience in UI automation (Selenium/Playwright), API \& backend testing, Java/Python/TypeScript, and modern CI/CD \& DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and database testing, including backend data validation.
* Experience testing microservices, distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, and event\-driven architectures.
* Hands\-on experience in Performance Testing, cloud\-native technologies (AWS/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes), and observability tools.
* Exposure to AI\-powered Quality Engineering, including AI\-assisted test solutions, automation development and testing AI\-enabled applications (LLMs, MCP, Agentic AI, RAG, Conversational AI, etc.).
* Strong analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
* Ability to review requirements, identify quality risks, and design effective test strategies.
* Self\-driven with a strong sense of ownership, excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a continuous learning mindset.


**With a Side Of (Additional Skills)**
* Exposure to Big Data or AI/ML products.
* Understanding of security testing concepts (OWASP, DAST, SAST) is a plus.


**Unleash Your Potential: What You Will Be Doing and Owning**
* Own end\-to\-end test strategy and quality sign\-off for assigned modules/services.
* Drive adoption of AI\-augmented testing practices across the team.
* Champion shift\-left testing and test pyramid principles within the SDLC.
* Partner with engineering leads to define performance benchmarks and SLAs.

* Interview \#2: Video interview with the Technical Teams (via MS Teams/F2F)
* Interview \#3: Video interview with the Hiring Manager (via MS Teams/F2F)
